TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1094.text: คุณไม่รู้ด้วยซ้ำ! คุณไม่รู้อะไรเกี่ยวกับโลกนี้!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1095.text: ความอ่อนแอตายชีวิตที่แข็งแกร่ง นั่นคือกฎ

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1096_1.text: Let me help you out with the restoration task. I beg your pardon? There is no need to turn down my offer. I'd really love to help! Please, I won’t take no for an answer... Wahhh!!!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1096_2.text: Ashley, I hate to mention it, but I think we are going to need 30 million gold to restore the old books in the museum that you ruined. I’ll send the invoice over to your father.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1097_1.text: Dear Nottingham, I’d love to hear about your recent adventures. Why don’t we have a chat over tea?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1097_2.text: Ashely, you are still very kind and considerate.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1098_1.text: Hm, does canned fish have an expiry date? Huh?! This blue stuff... Is this what mold is?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1098_2.text: Ashely? Jarvis tells me you smell sweet. Oh, Jarvis! You are not supposed to eat that! Jarvis!!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1099_1.text: Oops, I think I’ve accidentally burned all the badges of the Blue Blood Knights... They must have meant a lot to them... I am terribly sorry to have caused you so much worry.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1099_2.text: Well, tangible things can always be rebought. There’s no need to worry. Are you hurt anywhere? Oh, um.. you don’t need to come close to apologize.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1100_1.text: I’m still terribly sorry for what happened earlier... I’d like to offer you some tea in consolation. This tea... Oops, my bad!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1100_2.text: Ahhhhh!!! Hot, Hot!!! Spilled hot tea this time!!!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1101_1.text: What... are you? Your left arm is making a loud noise.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1101_2.text: I’m a human with a burning soul. Who are you?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1102_1.text: You are so loud... Can you lower your voice?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1102_2.text: You have to speak up for what you want! If no one’s listening, speak up louder to grab others' attention.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1103_1.text: Who... are you? I can sense some similarities between us...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1103_2.text: You are...? Oh, maybe we can be like good sisters.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1104_2.text: That straitjacket... You must be another victim of that ‘Artificial Goddess’ experiment. I can definitely relate to your hurt feelings.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1105_1.text: You cannot do anything by yourself?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1105_2.text: We are all incomplete when by ourselves.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1106_1.text: Huhu, it wasn’t a big deal. By the way, I think I’ve heard rumors that there is someone similar to the person you’re looking for in Thorn Forest of Devil Island.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1106_2.text: Uh, what did you whisper into my ears last night? I was quite drunk, so I don't quite remember... S-sorry. You even gave me a free drink and all...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1107_1.text: Welcome, we’re at your service, Miss Pushover.... I mean, our esteemed customer.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1107_2.text: Guess who’s here! I came as soon as I heard the news that all the nobles are going to attend this party! Ahem! ㅇ( >_<)ㅇThe boy must be here too, right...?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1108_1.text: I heard such wonderful things about your performance. The best actress deserves nothing less than the best stage. Please feel free to show off your skills at our grand theatre.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1108_2.text: You... You can recognize Demons? Good eye! I shall get to practice right away!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1109_1.text: Aha... Finally, here comes the last part of the armor I've been collecting! That right arm is all I need to complete my armor set. I want it very much.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1109_2.text: Excuse me... I heard my armor was here... Do you, by any chance, wish to re-sell it to me? I’ll pay you one way or another...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1110_1.text: Ozma, as long as it’s held as collateral, it belongs to me. If you wish to get it back, why don’t you make a bet with me? If you win, I will give it back to you. If not, you will transfer your technology to me. How's that?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1110_2.text: Ugh... All my latest inventions of ‘Ogrenology’... are locked as collateral... They are all public goods... What are they all here? G... Give them back...!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1111_1.text: I’m in no position to say this, but you’ve changed a lot since you were one of the Elite Four. Bloody Rose Jack.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1111_2.text: D-Don’t call me by that name! I haven’t changed. This is who I’ve always been!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1112_1.text: A small kid like you is Ku-Klip? You’ve been hiding your identity all this time?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1112_2.text: Why? Does it bother you that I’m a small kid? You're not so much taller than me. Well... I’m just trying to live a new life now!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1113_1.text: I have no business on the throne where Gordian is no longer seated.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1113_2.text: If you have even the slightest sense of honor, why don’t you show yourself at the Devil Castle one day?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1114_1.text: Owooooo! How's that? Sounds like a werewolf?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1114_2.text: Sounds like a normal wolf. This is what a werewolf sounds like. Kaowoooo!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1115_1.text: Ugh, I feel so much electrifying energy from her that I can’t even imitate... A born-to-be idol, indeed!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1115_2.text: Nice to meet you! I’m Cano! I hope we can perform together in Devil Island one day!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1116_1.text: I’m just exhausted... like the coffee waste remaining in the filter.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1116_2.text: Your sleep-fighting diligence! I wish the lazybones of Pumpkin City would learn from you!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1117_1.text: Yuria, how about a short rest? I can prepare you a cup of warm coffee.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1117_2.text: Oh... Yes, please. Thank you. I always look forward to drinking coffee you brewed.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1118_1.text: Sometimes we need something bitter to forget about our scars. Do you mind a bit of acidity in your coffee?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1118_2.text: Coffee is a type of drink that wants to show off its presence. If you wish to merely open your eyes, what about a cup of tea?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1120_1.text: Nico, it’s late already. Shouldn't you go to bed?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1120_2.text: You cannot sleep anyway! Just play this game with me, please!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1121_2.text: No worries, I’m not interested in manipulating game data! Not yet, at least...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1122_1.text: Mm... That person is getting on my nerves.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1122_2.text: If that’s what you truly want, you don't need to mind me anymore.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1123_1.text: Hey you! You look tired, want to drink this?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1123_2.text: This ingredient... How is Neth selling something like this?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1124_1.text: You know what you’re talking about! This is the zero-sugar energy drink that's selling out like crazy at convenience stores!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1124_2.text: I bought this drink on a 'buy two, get one free' deal, and I’ve fallen in love with how smoothly and sweetly it goes down my throat!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1125_1.text: Ahh! It’s not for kids! It’s too strong!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1125_2.text: ... What is this!? My heart is beating like crazy and my head is in the clouds.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1126_1.text: I beg your pardon? Where did you come from? Tell me!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1126_2.text: I know this taste! This is quite similar to the taste of the original drink!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1127_1.text: Oh, I'll give you more. Just tell me where you've tasted the original drink.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1127_2.text: Whoa! What a delightful taste I haven't savored for a long time. I've never imagined I would be tasting this in Grancia.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1128_1.text: Oh, you really love beverages, don't you? Do you want to try my specialty drink?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1128_2.text: Hmm, what's in it? The color looks familiar.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1129_1.text: I've named it 'Mouthful Heaven'. Do you want to try?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1129_2.text: I don't like trying strangely mixed drinks.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1130_1.text: Thanks for the offer, but I don't make drinks for personal profits.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1130_2.text: What? A drink that shows heaven? I envy your talent... This can make bettors have a false hope about... Hm, excuse me. Would you like to work as a bartender at my business place?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1132_1.text: People won't play with me... I will summon rain clouds!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1132_2.text: My nest is wet... I hope the rain stops.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1133_1.text: Sniff... I smell cool and fresh sea breeze... Your place... Is it already autumn there?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1133_2.text: It is still summer there. Nice to see you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1134_1.text: Ahh! What are you doing?! I'm not a demon but an elemental!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1134_2.text: Hm? Should I help you rest in peace?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1135_1.text: Hey, squirrel! I'll give you acorns-

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1135_2.text: You're rude, we just met... Huh?! It's the premium acorns grown from an oak tree in a sunny place!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1136.text: Just the thing to limber myself up.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1137.text: What is this armor? The pain from the wound disappeared the moment I put it on.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1138.text: I have come to meet you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1139.text: Looks like I am free now.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1140.text: Now is not the time to hesitate.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1141.text: The power of Astral World grows stronger the more you believe in it.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1142.text: Retreat not, for the sword of yours will do.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1143.text: Well, I suppose fighting is all that is left for you to do.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1144.text: Somehow you defied my prophecy and survived.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1145.text: This is not good enough for me!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1146.text: Although this is all I can do at the moment...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1147.text: I can’t believe I am wielding my sword to protect someone...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1148.text: Lower your head on ground and grovel!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1149.text: I'm contracted to study swordsmanship under Guts!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1150.text: Spirit of the wind, grant me strength...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1151.text: But Lady Farnese does insist this herself...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1152_1.text: Don't you play coy with me. Didn’t you call me to see it to the bitter end?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1152_2.text: All I wanted was to be better friends with you, Guts

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1153_2.text: Do not ask me to guide you. That is not my forte.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1154_1.text: Do you think anyone will listen to a kid like you?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1155_1.text: I wanted to cross swords with you once again after you went through hell.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1155_2.text: What is a punk like you doing with Griffith?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1156_1.text: This reminds me of when we first met.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1156_2.text: Don't you pretend to know me with that same smile and that same voice!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1157_1.text: Are you defying the beings not unlike angels or demons, who control your destiny?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1157_2.text: Yes, I will one day be landing a heavy blow.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1158_1.text: Continuing the Berserker's battle in that armor. It will cost you dearly.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1158_2.text: Still a pompous know-it-all, as ever.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1159_1.text: Uvala. It’s a shame you lost your big mouth. But… You can still come with me.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1159_2.text: I have no regrets left there. I don’t mind spending the rest of my life as a ‘little being’.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1160_1.text: Did you have fun scattering the constellations, Vasuki? Do you perhaps wish to tease the mortals again?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1160_2.text: Huh? I would rather not listen to the suggestion of a lousy captain who’s disguised as a human being.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1161_1.text: Sagara... I thought you took great pride in your immortal body that can survive without food.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1161_2.text: Sea of stars? I bet they don’t have sandwiches. You fool.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1162_1.text: Anavatapta. Are you still content with being in her shadow?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1162_2.text: ... My paradise is here. I’m willing to leave out anyone who disturbs the peace.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1163_2.text: You alone are the vessels of the Great King... You're dreaming of the dead.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1164_1.text: ...Lyodura. Manasa’s fourth brain. Right? Can I ask you to get in touch with her?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1164_2.text: I’m sorry, Nanda. I regret to tell you that I can’t. ...Ahahahaha! That gave me really creepy AI vibes.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1165_1.text: Skadi. How come you’re looking at me with those eyes?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1165_2.text:
Give it back Give it back Give it back
Give it back Give it back Give it back
Give it back Give it back Give it back

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1166_1.text: Is that all you've got even with Danan’s power? I’m disappointed. Warrior of Light.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1166_2.text: Ugh... Why does this remind me of the times I was scolded by my grandma as a kid?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1167_1.text: Who do you think you’re fooling?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1167_2.text: Aha, I always wondered what was beyond that ridiculously high mountains! Why don’t we form an alliance?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1168_1.text: I would rather not hang out with a horrible creature like you...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1168_2.text: Sniff... You smell like home. Do I know you by any chance?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1169_1.text: Well, I guess you didn’t recognize me even when we were together.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1169_2.text: Why are you staring at His face like that? I'm familiar with this eerie gaze...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1170_1.text: Pursuing someone so persistently... it’s quite offensive.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1171_1.text: Hmm... Compared to her, I would say 3 out of 100?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1171_2.text: Holy moly, you scared me! Huh? I’m hearing a human voice...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1172_1.text: Look at this... Wohoo... So pretty!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1172_2.text: What's this? Make me more! Make me a whole bunch!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1173_1.text: Oh, my... Ah, you scared the honk out of me! Please don't pop them!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1173_2.text: These are some feeble looking bubbles. Burst! Burst!!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1174_1.text: Professor, look at this. I can make it bigger than before. Isn’t it awesome?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1174_2.text: Oh, yes. You are a good learner. What ingredients did you put in?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1175_1.text: Black pepper... Capsaicin... Garlic... Haha, this should do...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1175_2.text: What is this dark energy I’m sensing? A lost soul who needs my guidance? Nope, guess not. Just a creepy person.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1176_1.text: Can I ask you for directions? Where can I find the Succubus Troupe? I must... I must watch the show...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1176_2.text: Oh, Lucky♡ Follow me. You’ll see the best show today! Yay! I'm getting a new fan today!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1177_1.text: Ha ha... Isn’t he looking at me? Well, there's nothing I can do. I can’t hide my beauty... That guy is quite handsome although his muscles are fake. Of course he's not as good looking as Achilles though.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1177_2.text: (Hm? She was totally a different person just a moment ago... She's so good at changing herself. I wonder how she does that.)

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1178_1.text: The more I get to know Athena, the more I realize how nice she is. Actually, even that word “nice” isn’t enough to describe her awesomeness! Ha ha!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1178_2.text: Don't be fooled, Briseis. You fell for Athena's wicked trick! It's just a shame I can't show you her dark intention.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1179_1.text: By any chance... Have you thought about early retirement? I can give you a whole lot of money if you retire now... Huhuhu...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1179_2.text: Wow, this is an unbelievable amount of money! I can retire right now with this money. But what’s the stake? What do you want in return?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1180_1.text: Argh, it's sticky! What's with the spider web? Let go of me! I'm going to call my grampa! He'll make you vanish into thin air!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1180_2.text: Got ya. The murderous beast who threatens to harm Athena...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1181_1.text: I... Uhm... I came here voluntarily. Nobody forced me! Ha ha! Surprised? Well... Let me put it this way, I wanted to test my limits. Huhuhu...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1181_2.text: Hmm... I kind of expected you would sneak in. And I think I know why you’re doing this.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1182_1.text: I’m not doing anything bad! Why not work with me? I can clear the misunderstanding!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1182_2.text: Why would you use such powerful dimensional magic on something evil?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1183_1.text: Let me give you important advice. If you crave too much knowledge, it will eventually lead to your downfall.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1183_2.text: Your knowledge of dimensional traveling... can you share some with me?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1184_1.text: Sounds good! When I have free time, I’ll come visit with my new friends!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1184_2.text: Hey, consultant! Come drink with me sometime! Bring some exotic tea from your travels while you’re at it!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1185_1.text: How’s the ‘afterlife’? That’s a place I’ve never been to.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1185_2.text: If you are willing to put down your life without resisting, I can take you there.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1186_1.text: We run an employment agency! We don’t do petty errands!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1186_2.text: Can you find someone for me...?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1187_1.text: Ma’am! I’d like 3 bowls of stew for breakfast!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1187_2.text: Are you trying to drive us out of business?! One’s enough!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1188_1.text: That’s not the right way of eating seonji stew...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1188_2.text: What is this spectacular taste...? This is wonderful!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1189_1.text: (Why is there a devil hanging out around here...?)

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1189_2.text: (Why is there a vampire eating stew here...?)

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1190_1.text: I’m not a demon, I’m a vampire! But most importantly, I’m a proud employee of Malsook’s Tavern!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1190_2.text: Why is there a demonic monster here living alongside humans?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1191_1.text: Kind sir! Come sit and have a splendid bowl of stew! I’ll personally prepare it for you!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1192_1.text: Nyah... I don’t understand! Why is everyone against me? Worship my big and beautiful explosions! You have no taste in art!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1192_2.text: Hahaha! What a mess you are! How entertaining! Okay, you want fame and money? I hereby name you the ‘Palace Mage’ of Grancia! Good luck with your new position!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1193_1.text: You dumb brutes! I can probably use your hard head as whetstone!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1193_2.text: Knights aren’t just brutes. We all seek knowledge as much as we seek physical strength. We needn’t hear insults from a bomb-loving maniac like you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1194_1.text: Kyah! How dare a dirty dog touch my ‘sacred’ bombs! Scram!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1194_2.text: *Sniff* Hmm? I came to capture an outlaw... You don’t look like Lupeow to me!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1195_1.text: That thing on your hand... It looks delicious! Give it!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1195_2.text: Nyah? A cat that was turned human through magic? How interesting! You will be my inspiration for my new Taiyaki recipe!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1196_1.text: Nyah... you... are an awesome cat! It’s the first time I met someone who understands my art! I don’t need money! Take it all!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1196_2.text: Nyah! Your artwork is truly amazing! They are all fascinating! They will surely help me become the best thief in the world! Can you sell me one?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1197_2.text: *Sob* How unfortunate... I’ve never seen a cat so unkempt and treated poorly... I will protect you. I will take care of you!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1198_1.text: Kyah! Unkempt?! Who are you to say that!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1198_2.text: *Sigh* Alexander... you gave this messy cat such a big responsibility. I can only see this as an insult to Pumpkin City.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1199_1.text: Ding! Your ‘Borbuddy Random Key Ring Set’ has arrived!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1199_2.text: Sshh!!! I told you to list the item as an office item!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1200_1.text: Ding! Your ‘Count Monte Daddy Long Legs Book’ has arrived! Hmm...? The recipient’s name is Spiny...? Wrong person!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1201_1.text: Ding! Your ‘Rainbow Underwear Set’ has arrived! Hmm...? The recipient’s name is Spiny...? Wrong person!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1201_2.text: ...Did you say Spyro ordered that item? Let me see!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1202_1.text: Ding! Your ‘Pressurized Mana Bomb’ has arrived!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1202_2.text: Woah! A mana bomb! This is made from Rapture Science technology! Wait... how did you get your hands on this?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1203_1.text: Ding! Your ‘Hair Loss Shampoo’ has arrived!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1203_2.text: My hairline has been receding lately... but I don’t need that!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1204_1.text: Ding! Your ‘Affogato Coffee Bean Gift Set’ has arrived!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1204_2.text: You delivered the beans I roasted... to me? How did you even get this? Did you take it from the shelves?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1205_2.text: I think I read it from a book before... Is there like a sleep bank somewhere? I want to buy some sleep.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1206_1.text: Jack, excuse me... Ugh! I don’t know if I should be polite towards you! How old are you?!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1206_2.text: I-I don’t know...! Call me whatever you want!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1207_1.text: I’ve seen you around here. You’re so polite!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1207_2.text: Kek... It’s Deokpal. Gotta greet him politely to make sure he doesn’t nag...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1208_1.text: Why are you dressed like that? You’re one of the Elite Four! Dress appropriately!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1208_2.text: ...I can’t even talk back to him since he gives me allowance.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1209_1.text: How dare you insult your elder! Your sister is a busy woman! Don’t lead her astray!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1209_2.text: Mr. Deokpal, you would look so handsome and cool if you can keep your mouth shut. Want to work at our Troupe?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1210_1.text: Sit down and listen. I’ve had enough with you. Vivian... VIVIAN! Stop acting like a child and do some work! You are a devil king! You need to become a role model for everyone! Do you realize how disappointed Gordian would be? You bask in the peace that Gordian brought to this world - you need guidance! FROM ME! Let’s begin by cleaning your room. You need to be more mature!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1211_1.text: Oh, child. I don’t blindly follow Sir Gordian’s orders. I respect his character and his abilities.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1211_2.text: Why do you only respect and follow Gordian? I’m the very first king!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1212_1.text: *Gasp* It’s a reaper...! Is it my time...? No! I still have too much work left to do! Please, sit down and listen...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1212_2.text: *Gasp* It’s Deokpal Choi, the spirit of darkness! One of my superior quit his job because of your intense nagging...! Please I’ll leave you be! Leave me alone!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1213_1.text: Demona? The true king? Don’t make me laugh. You live in peace all thanks to Gordian!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1213_2.text: I can’t let this slide. How dare you mock Demona, the very first king!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1214_1.text: You use a whip as a weapon? Does your generation have no shame?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1214_2.text: What are you blabbering about old man. You sound just like Aindel.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1215_1.text: You persist on coming back every year! This time, I will defeat you and recover my pride!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1215_2.text: Come now, I consider you a friend! Take me sightseeing around the village!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1216_1.text: You are of royal blood! Act like it!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1216_2.text: Sister, you used to dearly respect Sigrun. Didn’t you even write poems for her? Now’s your chance to read it for her.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1217_1.text: The reincarnation of Sigrun... is you? A lowly elf? How disappointing...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1217_2.text: Oh, you like honey-dipped bark too? Let’s go eat together!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1218_1.text: Are you looking Magnus? I saw him last with the captain of the Silver Archers. You must truly be ashamed of your shameless captain.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1219_1.text: Are you the botanist who was successful in mass producing Royal Beans? You shouldn’t have. The common people do not deserve such luxury.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1220_1.text: Sister Wolfram! Thank you for giving up on succeeding the throne! I have a chance now!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1220_2.text: The elves must open up to the other races to thrive.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1221_1.text: I’m so glad that you remained at the castle. Our realm would’ve been in a worse state without you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1221_2.text: I’m honored you think that way. But you should still go and scold your daughter...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1222_1.text: ...I see that the mercenary captain was able to deal with the overgrown Royal Beans. *Sigh* I wonder if the Cow King you foolishly sold off is doing well...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1222_2.text: My Lord... I’m so sorry... Please don’t abandon me... Sir Gordian...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1223_1.text: It’s nice seeing you not covered in blood of your enemies. Celebrity life suits you, Charlotte.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1223_2.text: It’s a bit embarrassing, but I think it’s worth it. Do you wanna try wearing this, Gordian?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1224_1.text: Do you know of anything about the giant robots that have been appearing in our realm? I came to you thinking you’d know.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1224_2.text: Sir G-G-Gordian...! Hehe... what brings you here your highness?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1225_1.text: Vivian...! What will it take for you to mature as a person?! Take responsibility!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1225_2.text: You are the one that fled from your responsibility! You are a terrible father!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1226_1.text: My dear daughter, how have you been? Is your sister kind to you? How’s your mother?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1226_2.text: I’m always happy daddy! You should hurry and return home!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1228_1.text: W-why are you doing this to me...?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1228_2.text: The seductive magical princess Asmodeus has arrived-!☆ Hehe, how is it? Do you enjoy my presence...?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1229_1.text: Ehem... are you perhaps Vivian’s friend?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1229_2.text: Vivian is a lazy good-for-nothing that “thinks” I’m her friend! I bet she was spoiled as a child! Her parents should be ashamed!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1230_1.text: Oh I know her! She dances really well but can’t sing, right?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1230_2.text: You don’t need to continue the family tradition! Do what you want to do! Follow your own dreams!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1231_1.text: Woah... even you, a priestess, had a childhood...?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1231_2.text: Looking at you reminds me of my childhood. The days I spent training my fists to become the very best...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1232_1.text: WOW! It’s Yuna, the Magic Girl! I’m a huge fan! Please give me your autograph!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1232_2.text: Eh, you’re a fan? Uhm... I’ve never ran into this kind of situation... what do I do...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1233_2.text: I’m lucky to have such a cute junior colleague to work with! While you’re studying abroad, leave everything to me!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1234_1.text: Computer? It looks weird... I don’t like it.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1234_2.text: Oh, I heard you’re quite a genius little girl. Are you perhaps interested in computers and hacking?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1235_1.text: Do you remember me? You isolated me and abandoned me. Now I’m a beautiful person.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1236_1.text: Master, is this how you do it?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1236_2.text: Put that in there... expand it... yes! Perfect!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1237_1.text: Hehe... do you remember how many pieces of bread you’ve eaten so far?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1237_2.text: You...! How many mages from my city have you eaten!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1238_2.text: You look like you’ll have a long life.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1239_1.text: I’m happy you took a liking to me... but I want to take things slowly...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1239_2.text: You are a being that was born from lies, isolation, and false expectations. You’re just like me. Let’s be good friends.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1240_1.text: I heard you were an esteemed bounty hunter. I guess the rumors were exaggerated. You’re a fool, you don’t know your place.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1240_2.text: I’m extremely persistent, you see. Let’s see who laughs in the end.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1241_1.text: The hero of the Operation Cattle Drive, Sheriff Maxi! What an honor to meet you. You’re an inspiration to us all, please accept this small gift.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1241_2.text: Wow! I worked in the Wastelands for a long time, but you’re the first to say such nice things to me! Wanna touch my Horse Head Ornament?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1242_1.text: Yeah, I’m lobbying. So what? What are you going to do about it?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1242_2.text: Your “small gift” to Maxi is a new office, two horses, and money to fund us for 2 years...? Are you trying to buy us out?!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1243_1.text: You should try visiting the Hideout. You’d love the place, it’s perfect for you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1243_2.text: Lady Milady. How’s the old man? Has he retired? I haven’t seen him in a while.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1244_1.text: How scary. Your remark absolutely terrifies me.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1244_2.text: I’m looking into your background, Milady. I’m sure you’ve done “bad” things in the Wastelands.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1245_1.text: Interesting offer... I will think about it.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1245_2.text: Hmm... I’ve also been curious about this ‘Ibelin.’ We should team up for a while.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1246_1.text: Did you know? I quite like you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1247_1.text: It seems like the whole event really shocked you...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1247_2.text: I’ve prepared my revenge against the little girl who mocked my tea. Now we are this close to finding and dispatching her. The wind and the rain is brushing against the window. The calm before the storm. Those who mocked my tea, and those who are still mocking my tea; I have not said a single word to them as I speak with my actions. Let’s see who the real loser is.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1248_1.text: That’s an easy request. It’s the least I can do for you. The person you are looking for is ‘Levine Ludovico.’ A famous person in Neth.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1248_2.text: I don’t want anything else... The enemy of the 9th Falcons Division... Give me a name...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1249_1.text: ...And leave my Familia? Don’t joke with me.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1249_2.text: You... your skills in management are extraordinary... I have a job offer for you. Do you want to try leading an entire civilization at a faraway galaxy?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1250_1.text: I acknowledge your strength. But unlike Ibelin, you don’t have the class to bring order to the Wastelands.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1250_2.text: So what? Did I ask? What can you even do about it?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1251_1.text: Dragon Fist Nari! Do you remember me? I’m Shura Lord Hwangbo!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1251_2.text: Aww, look at this cute little thing. Where are you from little girl?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1252_1.text: Hmm? You are quite old, and yet you’ve never killed someone before? Loser♡ Weakling♡

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1253_1.text: I’m so, so sorry to hear that...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1253_2.text:
It was a hot summer day. Both the sky and earth shook that day. It felt like the end of the world.When I heard the news, no food tasted delicious, and no beautiful sight moved my heart.I couldn’t sleep at night, and I couldn’t work during the day.All my friends left my side, no one but me, myself, and I.Sometimes I wonder. “Maybe it was all a dream. Maybe it’s a misunderstanding.”
So I rush to check, only to realize it’s reality. A past that can’t be undone.Day after day, we’re reminded of what we lost. We live in agony... What am I talking about? My favorite dumpling shop recently closed down.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1254_1.text: Immunity to poison? Ha! What a useless thing to have mastered all your life! In the end, a weapon as simple as a kitchen knife can kill you♡

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1254_2.text: Well, I started practicing it to lose weight...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1255_1.text: Ok boomer... The things you say are just, ew♡

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1255_2.text: I am a steam engine! Chugga Chugga Chugga Chugga!!! I will crush you!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1256_1.text: Like I’d know! I hate this more than anybody!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1256_2.text: This is quite peculiar... You have a spirit of an old martial arts master, but your physical appearance is that of a little girl. What happened?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1257_1.text: You hide behind your monstrous daughter, but you can’t fool me. You act like a loser♡, but I can see you’re a master of the blade.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1257_2.text: Hmm... what are you saying? How can a blind man like me wield a sword?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1258_1.text: What is this? A jiangshi? What loser♡ made this? It’s so crudely made... even I can do better!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1259_1.text: Found a loser♡ who’s been consumed by darkness! Weak♡ What a sight♡

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_1259_2.text: Have you lost your mind? At such a young age, too. Not worth my time.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_963_1.text: ตึ่งๆ ตึ่ง ตึ่งๆ ตึ่ง ! ตึ่งๆ ตึ่ง! ตึ่งๆ โป๊ะ!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_963_2.text: ... ฉันถูกขับไล่... โดยมือกลองน้องสาวคนนั้น?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_964_1.text: เฮ้สาว คุณดูแข็งทื่อ มานี่ฉันไม่กัดหรอก ฉันจะทำให้หัวของคุณชัดเจน

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_968_1.text: ฉันยังลืมภาพนั้นไม่ได้ ฉันเห็นกลุ่มนักรบ Nosgardian เดินผ่านพายุหิมะ!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_983_2.text: ฉันได้ยินมาว่าคุณประดิษฐ์คิดค้นอะไรแปลกๆ? เด็กสมัยนี้พึ่งพาของสะดวกมากเกินไป... การมองหาความสะดวกสบายในทุกสิ่งไม่เคยดีเลย... ตอนเด็กๆ ตอนนั้น Demona ยังอยู่แถวๆ นี้...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_984_1.text: โอ้ อาจจะเป็นไปได้... แม้ว่าจะมีผลข้างเคียงบางอย่าง... เช่น ของหวานที่ผลิตในปริมาณมากจะไม่ละลายในสองร้อยปีหรืออะไรทำนองนั้น...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_984_2.text: อะแฮ่ม ขอโทษ ฉันสงสัยว่า... ถ้าคุณสามารถทำขนมที่ไม่มีวันละลายหรือสายการผลิตของโรงงานเพื่อผลิตขนมจำนวนมากได้หรือไม่?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_985_1.text: ฉันเห็นว่าเพื่อนที่มีประโยชน์ได้รับความไว้วางใจให้อยู่กับตำนานแห่ง Primal Flames ขณะที่ฉันหลับ ฉันค่อนข้างภูมิใจ คุณต้องการลูกอมไหม?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_985_2.text: ลูกอม? เจ้าคิดว่าข้าจะล่อใจง่ายๆ ด้วยขนมงั้นหรือ? ... รสอะไร...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_986_1.text: อยู่ในข้อตกลงที่ดีกับ Korin ทำเพื่อฉันได้ไหม เราทุกคนอยู่ในรองเท้าเดียวกัน

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_986_2.text: ฉันไม่อยากยุ่งเกี่ยวกับเด็กไร้เดียงสาที่สิ้นหวังคนนั้น... ถ้ามันเป็นคำสั่งของทานาทอส ฉันเดาว่าฉันคงไม่มีทางเลือกแล้ว

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_987_1.text: โอเค ไม่เป็นอะไร. คุณอาจจะถอยกลับตอนนี้

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_987_2.text: อะไร? ยามะเคยเป็นหัวหน้าของ Death Angel ที่หยาบคายจากตะวันตก?! ท-แล้วพูดอะไรกับเธอ! เธอยังคงดำเนินต่อไปเกี่ยวกับเขตอำนาจศาลของเธอและอะไรก็ตาม... และเธอก็ปฏิบัติกับฉันมาก...!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_988_1.text: ใช่ Korin บอกฉันแล้ว คุณเกิดและเติบโตบนพรมแดนของชีวิตและความตาย? ...มันต้องเจ็บปวดอย่างน่าสมเพช บีฮยองรังฉลาด คุณสามารถเรียนรู้มากมายจากเขา

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_988_2.text: คุณ...มีใบหน้าที่เเปลกๆ เห็นทั้งหน้าเด็กและคนแก่ในตัวคุณ...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_989_1.text: อ่า เกือบลืมไปเลย ใช่. ออกไปทำข้อตกลงที่ดีกับ Woopa

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_989_2.text: Quaxolotl เทพเจ้าแห่งความตายและขี้เถ้า! พระเจ้า ฉันขอร้อง ได้โปรดปล่อยฉันออกไป! ฉันอยู่ที่นี่มานานพอแล้ว!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_990_1.text: Hmm, a soul dark as jet-black night and sticky. Seems delicious, but I cannot eat too much of it in this body. I will have to say no.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_990_2.text: Truly lucky to meet such a graceful woman in this backwater region of Valencia. Will you have lunch with me sometime?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_991_1.text: I can hear the bones creaking all the way here. What say you? Serve me and prolong your life almost at an end?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_991_2.text: I doubt that my creed permits me to call that a proper life.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_992_1.text: Keke... Alright, I will remember to have your permission before leeching your ancestral energy.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_992_2.text: I appreciate purifying the energy of the Fortress, but next time, will you please visit with my permission, for I am the lord of this castle?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_993_1.text: What nonsense. Do you hold emotions for petty insects?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_993_2.text: Ugh... Another addition to his list of hangers-on. You, do not step out of the audience chamber!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_994_1.text: You try to limit me with the shallow mind of mortals?! You will pay dearly for your indolence... I mean, insolence.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_994_2.text: Having been in the darkness taught me one thing. You... You hold horrible darkness underneath your pure white facade.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_995_1.text: I have no such thing as friends. ...G-giving me that eye does not change things.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_996_1.text: This scent of ocean breeze from you... You must be a mariner by trade. May I go take a look at your ship?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_996_2.text: A warship is no tourist attraction... Hmph, you’re no Seiren, but what a bewitching voice you have! I admit it’s hard to turn away your request.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_997_1.text: Thank you. You have a charming voice too.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_997_2.text: Wow, you have a beautiful voice. Like the Elder Sister of the Sea before her voice went hoarse! ...W-wait, you are a male?!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_998_1.text: Pardon me, that was not my intention...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_998_2.text: I understand you have no ill will... But will you be more prudent when making "requests"? People could get hurt while doing you a favor.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_999_1.text: What a shame. I lost my memories too... Perhaps we were friends before.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_999_2.text: Hm, how peculiar. I doubt we met before... But I still find you familiar.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_35.text: เขาเติบโตขึ้นมาในฐานะเด็กผู้มั่งคั่งในปราสาทขนาดใหญ่ งานอดิเรกของน็อตติงแฮมคือการสำรวจทุกซอกทุกมุมของปราสาทของเขา อยู่มาวันหนึ่ง เขาสะดุดกับสถานที่ที่ซ่อนอยู่ซึ่งนำไปสู่ห้องใต้ดินใต้ดิน ที่นั่นเขาพบนักโทษและลักลอบขนทรัพย์สิน เขาตกตะลึงกับการค้นพบวิธีที่ไม่ยุติธรรมซึ่งครอบครัวของเขาได้รับความมั่งคั่ง เขารู้สึกละอายใจกับอภิสิทธิ์และความฟุ่มเฟือยที่เขาได้รับโดยไม่รู้ตัว

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_36.text: เสี่ยวผิงถังออกเดินทางเพื่อค้นหาและคืนความโปรดปรานให้กับผู้มีพระคุณของเธอ แต่เรื่องราวของเธอบิดเบี้ยวเป็นข่าวลือเท็จที่กล่าวว่า "ผู้นำคนต่อไปของ House Tang กำลังจะแก้แค้นนักสมุนไพรที่พยายามจะลอบสังหารเธอ" ดังนั้น Lassie กำลังพยายามอยู่ให้พ้นสายตาเธอ

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_37.text: เธอเป็นครูอย่างเป็นทางการที่ดูแลชั้นเรียนเจี๊ยบที่สถานเลี้ยงเด็กกำพร้าที่ดำเนินการตาม Order of the Goddess แต่ในความเป็นจริงเธอสอนเด็ก ๆ ว่าจะเป็นผู้สอบสวนที่ซักถามและลอบสังหารเป้าหมายได้อย่างไร นอกเหนือจากทักษะการสอนของเธอผู้คนรอบตัวเธอยังกังวลเกี่ยวกับการขาดชีวิตขั้นพื้นฐานและทักษะทางสังคม เพื่อนคนเดียวของเธอคือ Luicilla ที่ผ่านการฝึกกับเธอ พวกเขาไม่ได้แสดงความเร่งด่วนอย่างเปิดเผย แต่ทั้งคู่กำลังดิ้นรนเพื่อหาคู่สมรสก่อนที่นายกรัฐมนตรีจะเริ่มจางหายไป

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_39.text: Hina was born with extraordinary spiritual potential, but her true talent lies in her brain; she is a genius. Hina’s math teacher at Neth Academy took notice of how smart Hina was and ran a test in secret to measure her intelligence - and the test result displayed that Hina is in the top 1% of the population in intelligence. Ever since the test results came in, the Neth Academy is trying to persuade Hina into attending the academy’s ‘Gifted Education Program’.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_LIMITED_EQUIP_6_.text: Dura เป็น AI ที่แทนที่หนึ่งในสี่ของ AI เสริมทุก ๆ 200 ปี แต่หลังจากเหตุการณ์ที่เกิดขึ้น มันก็จบลงด้วยการร่างในรอยแยกมิติเพียงอย่างเดียว Dura ใช้เวลาเพียงห้านาทีในการกลับสู่ความเป็นจริง แต่ประสบการณ์ที่คำนวณได้ของเธอมีเวลา 20,000 ปีในการล่องลอย เพราะความเหลื่อมล้ำในครั้งนี้ ทำให้สมองของดูร่ากลายเป็นคนวิกลจริต

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_6_35.text: แม้ว่าสวรรค์ของแมวที่เธอสร้างขึ้นใกล้กับ Pumpkin City ตอนนี้ได้กลายเป็นเป้าหมายของทั้ง Pumpkin City และ Animal Loving Adventurers แต่ก็ไม่มีอะไรมากที่สามารถทำได้เพราะมันเป็นไปไม่ได้ที่จะพิชิตสถานที่โดยไม่ทำร้ายแมวที่ปกป้อง Anima อย่างดุเดือด

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_6_37.text:
เกิดอ่อนแอ Anne ใช้ชีวิตทั้งชีวิตบนเตียง เธอมีปฏิสัมพันธ์กับครอบครัวและครูสอนหนังสือจากบ้านของเธอเท่านั้น เธอไม่เคยเห็นโลกข้างนอกไม่มีประสบการณ์กับมิตรภาพหรือความรัก ทุกสิ่งที่เธอรู้มาจากหนังสือที่เธออ่านหรือเรื่องราวที่เธอได้ยิน Anne ใช้เวลาทุกวันจินตนาการว่าเธอถูกล้อมรอบไปด้วยเพื่อนร่วมงานของเธอและความรักครั้งแรกของเธอจะเป็นอย่างไร น่าเศร้าที่เธอเสียชีวิตบนเตียงก่อนที่จะได้สัมผัสกับสิ่งเหล่านี้ที่เธอจินตนาการไว้ เธออายุเพียง 19 ปีเมื่อเธอจากไป มันคงจะน่าสงสารเกินไปที่ใครบางคนจะตายเมื่ออายุ 19 ปี

เธอเคยได้ยินว่าความรู้สึกสุนทรียภาพของเธอนั้นแปลกประหลาด บางทีเธออาจได้รับอิทธิพลจากแม่ของเธอซึ่งเป็นศิลปินลัทธิคิวบิส ขอบคุณแม่ของเธอ Anne ได้เรียนรู้วิธีการดูสิ่งต่างๆ จากมุมมองที่แตกต่าง

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_6_39.text: Nene can virtually go to any place in the universe at will using her Deer-dog, Vivi’s dimensional traveling ability. While traveling areas outside of Hasla, Nene learned a lot of valuable information that can’t be found in Hasla. However, she never shares outside information with the people back home, as it can “do more harm than good” if they know.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_6_40.text: Lime speaks like a human and acts like a normal person “most of the time”, but she is simply following Lilith, her master’s instructions; she does not fully understand human behavior. And although she looks at ease, she is constantly using magic inside her body to replicate her cells to prolong her life. Lime’s biggest fear is ‘death’.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_LIMITED_AUCTION_.text: Milady lives by a code. No matter how big of a mistake her subordinates make, she forgives them, once. But if one of them happen to repeat the same mistake twice, Milady shows no mercy. When Milady took over her grandfather’s organization, she saw countless men that betrayed her grandfather, begging for forgiveness, while secretly planning other ways to betray the organization. She swore to never forgive those who do not deserve it.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_PA_6_34.text: ในฐานะผู้ประดิษฐ์ 'Ogrenology' Ozma ได้สร้างสิ่งประดิษฐ์ที่มีประโยชน์อื่นๆ เช่นกัน แต่เธอไม่สามารถอธิบายกลไกเบื้องหลังที่แน่นอนได้ หลังจากการประดิษฐ์ที่อัศจรรย์สองสามอย่าง เช่น เครื่องกำเนิดพลังงานที่ไม่มีที่สิ้นสุดหรือหัวฝักบัวไร้สาย ซึ่งจะทำให้วิศวกรของ Neth ตกตะลึง ตอนนี้เกาะปีศาจก็กลายเป็นสถานที่ที่น่าอยู่อย่างน่าประหลาด...

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_PA_6_37.text:
ในวันแรกของการบันทึกอัลบั้มของเธอ Uzume ร้องเพลงและวิญญาณของเธอออกมา โชคดีที่การร้องเพลงของเธอได้รับการจัดเรียงและแก้ไขโดยผู้ผลิตแผ่นเสียงที่มีทักษะ พนักงานทำงานทั้งกลางวันและกลางคืนเป็นเวลา 17 วันและใช้เวลาพักร้อนนานหลังจากนั้น

ในวันแรกของคอนเสิร์ตของ Uzume ผู้ชมบางคนพยายามหลบหนี แต่ทางออกทั้งหมดถูกล็อคดังนั้นพวกเขาจึงถูกบังคับให้ฟังเพลงทั้งหมดของเธอ ต่อมา Uzume ทำให้ทุกคนตกใจอีกครั้งโดยอ้างว่าเธอเห็นผู้ชมร้องไห้เพราะการแสดงของเธอ

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_PA_6_39.text:
Drinking enough energy drinks to recover from fatigue properly can help her exercise a tremendous amount of power. On the other hand, energy drink shortage can cause instant fatigue and sleep on her. This is because the energy drink sold in Neth is the same as the nectar from Life Support System Device in Heaven but diluted to suit the taste of people in Neth.
She always wants to repay her favor to Affogato, who has been taking care of her like a real father, but her innate laziness is delaying this payback.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_PA_6_40.text:
Since this elemental was born out of human prayers, she loves humans a lot. That is why her emotion gets mixed up with feelings of anger, sadness, and naughtiness whenever she is disliked by humans. The weather reflects Kumori's emotions. When she feels depressed, the sky is covered with rain clouds, and it starts raining if she feels like crying. 

She's still a little child who can't properly control her own feelings.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_PA_LIMITED_EIGHTH_6.text: Since ancient times, the gaze sent by something within the Sea of Stars has terrified countless mortals. One day, a wizard claiming that fear comes from ignorance started his own research to uncover the mystery behind the gaze. He finally crossed the mental horizon and arrived at the Sea of Stars, after defeating the ‘Death’ he had created, but there was nothing found there. The wizard later titled himself the Owner of the Void and ascended to the position of Transcendent to become one of the Eight Great Dragon Kings, but he never managed to uncover the truth behind the identity of the gaze.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_PA_LIMITED_ENT_6_EV.text: Evgenia believes that elves are superior over every other race - and is why she hates the fact that the Elven Realm is currently under Grancia’s control. Evgenia is planning to overthrow the Grancia Empire with her Elven followers.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_PR_6_36.text:
เขาใช้สาวเหล็กที่เขาแบกไว้บนหลังของเขาเป็นถุงนอนเมื่อเขานอนในที่โล่ง
หลายคนขมวดคิ้วกับทะเลทรายซาฮาราและพฤติกรรมแปลกประหลาดของเขา แต่บางคนมองว่าเขาเป็นแรงบันดาลใจที่มีชีวิตหรือแม้กระทั่งเป็นหัวหน้าบาทหลวง ชนชั้นสูงของผู้ศรัทธาในเทพธิดาตราหน้าเขาว่าเป็นคนนอกรีตและทรมานเขาเพื่อเปลี่ยนให้เขาไปสู่เส้นทางที่ถูกต้อง แต่ในไม่ช้าพวกเขาก็ยอมแพ้หลังจากเห็นเขาสนุกกับการทรมาน

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_PR_6_37.text:
เธอผล็อยหลับไปเมื่อเธอฟังเพลงที่อ่อนโยนและผ่อนคลาย
เธอสามารถเปลี่ยนอะไรก็ได้ที่เธอจับเป็นกลองชุด สิ่งที่เธอพบรอบตัวเธอ เธอก็เคาะมันด้วยมือ
เป็นเรื่องยากที่จะบอกว่าเธอจริงจังกับการสืบทอดมรดกของครอบครัวหรือไม่เพราะเธอเป็นสัตว์ประจำกลุ่ม อย่างไรก็ตาม ทัศนคติเชิงบวกและกระฉับกระเฉงของเธอมักจะช่วยให้เธอแก้ปัญหาที่ซับซ้อนได้อย่างง่ายดายด้วยผลลัพธ์ที่ดีที่สุด บางคนถือว่าเธอเป็นนักยุทธศาสตร์ที่ยิ่งใหญ่ ในขณะที่คนอื่นๆ มองว่าเธอเป็นเด็กที่เอาแต่ใจเพราะโชคช่วย

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_PR_6_39.text:
The most recent accident occurred when she attended the grand banquet in Grancia as she made her debut at the social gathering. She accidentally stepped on Victoria’s foot with a pointed heel while dancing, then tripped over Tia’s leg who came to check on Victoria, which caused the champagne glass tower to collapse, shattering all the glasses and ruining the banquet for good. Paying damages for the custom-made champagne glasses with blue jewels was quite costly, and so were the hospital charges for Victoria and Tia's injury. Let’s not forget about the look on devastated Lednas’ face, who poured her heart and soul into the banquet.
Nonetheless, being the lovable person that she is, Ashley was neither overly criticized nor hated by people around her. Sometimes, people who know of her difficult situation refuse the compensation she’s willing to offer, but Ashley, who doesn’t like being an inconvenience to others, goes out of her way to pay for her mistakes and offer an apology, even if it means taking out a loan.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_PR_6_40.text:
She's always thankful to the savior who saved her from danger when she was a little child. She is determined to return a favor if she happens to meet the person again while traveling in Hasla. 

 One day, some people began to taste the beverage offered by Ranee and soon they fell in love with the drink and its resultant euphoria effect. They eventually lost a sense of reality after overdrinking it without stopping. They got addicted to Ranee's drink, and did nothing but drink it all day. Being afraid of the unintended side effects of the drink, Ranee stopped serving the drinks. But the drink addicts resolved to violence and began to attack Ranee. Shocked by their violence, Ranee declared that she would serve only one sip a day for each customer.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_PR_6_41.text: When Anton was on his journey around Hasla, he was a renowned epicure with many who read his food reviews. His reviews were always objectively written, and his descriptions on the food he tasted were detailed and well thought out. That is until all of his reviews began to only praise a certain dish called ‘Seonji Stew.’

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_PR_LIMITED_TRADE_6_.text: Lacrimoso มักจะช่วยเหลือผู้อื่นและทุ่มเททุกอย่างเพื่อช่วยเหลือคนขัดสน ผู้ติดตามของ Lacrimoso กังวลว่าเขาอาจถูกเอาเปรียบจากผู้ที่มีเจตนาร้าย แต่ถึงกระนั้นคนที่น่ารังเกียจที่สุดก็ปฏิรูปตนเองในที่สุดและทำสิ่งที่ "เล็กน้อยที่สุด" ของ Lacrimoso อย่างสุดความสามารถหลังจากใช้เวลาร่วมกับเขา

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WA_6_37.text: เขาไม่มีใครถ้าเขาถอดอุปกรณ์เสริมบอลลูนหรือแต่งหน้า สิ่งที่เขามักจะได้ยินคือ 'อืม ... ฉันรู้จักคุณไหม?' และ 'โอ้คุณดูเหมือนคนที่ฉันรู้จัก'

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WA_6_38.text: Her fan club, the Red Cape Squad, got its name after the Red Cape Squad, a Demon unit under her command when she was one of the Elite Four.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WA_6_39.text:
Born and raised in a laboratory, she is approximately one year old, but due to the power of scientific technology, has the intellectual maturity of a 15-year-old.

She has five senses that are several times more sensitive than the others due to the influence of the Artificial Goddess experiment. For this reason, a normal voice may sound loud like a roaring thunder and the human body smell may be perceived too disgusting to bear for her, which explains her edginess and acute sensitivity.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WA_6_40.text:
Briseis is from a seemingly distinguished Roman family. However, the truth is her family is actually a house of assassins that has been secretly growing power over generations.

Briseis was spoiled by her shameless grampa when growing up. People regarded her as a prodigy when she managed to get on her grampa's shoulder without anybody knowing about it when she was just a baby. She can be a bit rude because everybody used to praise her even when she tried to pull pranks on them, such as plucking the beard of adults or ticking them. However, people well accept her as a cute rascal because she's easygoing and has no ill intentions. 

Her transforming skills are flawless. However, her peculiar laughs and gestures soon give her away. Most people are aware of her disguise, but they just go along with her play not to embarrass her.

She was very happy when she was engaged to Achilles. She was determined to become the perfect fiance to match his nobleness, but the rose-colored glasses came off as he began to expose his weaknesses. Nonetheless, she decided to bear with him in benevolence because she thought only she could embrace his kind.

Her grampa betrothed her to Achilles because he did not want her to succeed his assassination business. Therefore, upon finding out that Achilles had been using her as an assassin, he was enraged and tried to break off the engagement and assassinate Achilles. However, he had to give up on that plan upon hearing her saying that she was truly in love with Achilles.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WA_6_41.text: The quick delivery service QuickDash that Tramontana works for is currently drowning under waves of copyright and misdelivery lawsuits from both individuals and organizations. From delivering unreleased products to rival companies, thus allowing them to file a patent first, to delivering food that hadn’t been ordered to poor customers on diets, thus making them ruin all their hard work, QuickDash is facing a lot of heat. Tramontana had the CEO of the company sweating bullets, living in terror, because she kept hacking into their system to run deliveries even though they revoked her delivery license.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WA_LIMITED_AUCTION_.text: In her(?) previous life, Tian Mo was a well-esteemed martial arts master who was feared by the people of his land. As such, Tian Mo felt utterly devastated when he was reincarnated as a girl. However, Tian Mo didn’t fret for too long; she immediately started shaping her body and spirit to once again climb the hierarchy of the martial arts world. However, not too long after, Tian Mo had an unfortunate accident during an intensive meditation session. Tian Mo’s fragile body couldn’t bear her powerful spirit and went out of control. The accident permanently damaged her mind and spirit - she can no longer bear the urge to call those who are older than her, losers♡.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WA_LIMITED_EIGHTH_6.text: The place where Leonia had obtained the ‘Heart of the Star’ that later became the material for Caliburn was a forgotten temple in the northern remote area, now blocked by the ‘Insurmountable Mountains’. According to the inscription next to the Heart of the Star enshrined in the center of the temple, Hasla was originally part of a certain planet. It was torn apart in the aftermath of an experiment conducted by the ancients, which was how it came to wander through the crevice of dimensions. Another inscription next to it said that Hasla was a mobile fortress that had invaded another planet to steal the Heart of the Star, and next to it said Hasla was just a stage in a virtual space that did not exist. It made Leonia stop thinking no more.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WA_LIMITED_TRADE_6_.text: รู้เพียงว่าเขาดูเด็กกว่าเธอมากและสนใจเด็กผู้หญิงที่มีมนต์ขลังเธอกระโดดไปสู่ข้อสรุปที่รีบร้อนและกลายเป็นผู้หญิงที่มีมนต์ขลัง☆สาว☆ เป้าหมายของเธอคือการทำความคุ้นเคยกับวัฒนธรรมของเยาวชนปีศาจในปัจจุบันและถือการสนทนาอย่างต่อเนื่องกับเด็กหนุ่มที่อ่อนเยาว์ อย่างไรก็ตามการกลับมารวมกันเป็นเวลานานหลายปีโดยไม่มีการโต้ตอบทำให้มันยากมากสำหรับเธอที่จะอยู่กับจังหวะการสนทนาของผู้อื่นและเข้าใจวัฒนธรรมป๊อปของคนรุ่นใหม่

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_6_37.text:
เขามีผมหยิกเป็นลอนที่ซับซ้อน ดังนั้นเขาจึงเคยซ่อนมันไว้ใต้กระโปรงหน้ารถเมื่อตอนที่เขายังเด็ก ตอนนี้ หลังจากที่ได้เรียนรู้ว่าอะไรที่ทำให้นักรบชาว Nosgardian โดดเด่นจากฝูงชน เขาก็รู้สึกสบายใจกับผมหยิกหยักศกของเขา
เขารักการออกกำลังกาย แต่มีกล้ามเนื้อไม่มากเนื่องจากเขามีความอยากอาหารไม่ดีและอ่อนแอโดยธรรมชาติ

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_6_39.text:
An inactive brain due to coma or fainting will cause an immediate state of suspended animation. Her body can keep itself active instead of her brain until the caffeine in the body runs out, but if the body is not supplied with enough caffeine in time, the brain will stop working and die.
The relationship with Niko began as he helped Nico, who was then being chased by Neth, hide inside his coffee shop.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_6_40.text:
During her years in the Pumpkin City, she kept failing in the classes. She wasn't interested in the four elements of magic, which were the main subjects of the school. Classmates thought she was a weirdo because she was always interested in other magics which had nothing to do with school grades. But she caught Estelle's attention and they began to study the bubble amplifying magic together. Fascinated with the magic, Thalia dug into it even further. Thalia was only interested in bubble magics, and she was stressed out from unnecessary tips and advices about how to raise school grades or maintain good friendship. Having decided that bubbles were the only thing Thalia needed, she dropped out of school and returned home to focus her research on bubble magics.

Ever since figuring out how to use bubble magics as weapon, she has been studying how to make it more powerful. She's currently working on developing 'Eye Stinging Bubble' where capsaicin and black peppers are added to irritate enemy eyes. Also, she is developing 'Slippery Bubble!' mixed with ogre extract, which feels obnoxiously offensive when stepping on it.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_6_41.text: Even though he appears to be a young man on the outside, on the inside he’s an ornery, grumpy old man. The lecturing he constantly spouts based on outdated values will literally eat away at your soul. Even in life, he valued seniority above all else, so his attitude towards Jack -- who he wasn’t sure whether was older or younger than him -- was a bit ambiguous. But on the other hand, seeing Deokpal truly respect and even follow Gordian, who was younger than him, made it a little unclear whether he had any flexibility or not. Luckily for him, having been a skilled gat-maker, there were lots of demon folk who liked to wear black gats as fashion pieces. Those who complimented his gats saw a much softer side of him.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_LIMITED_ENT_6_GO.text: When Gordian lost his wife, Rebecca, the mother of Vivian, he took in Nia as his concubine and gave birth to Rachel. The nobles of his realm deemed Nia and Rachel unworthy of royal treatment, as Nia was a demon born of lowly status. But Gordian loved his family all the same. Whatever it took, whether through ‘peaceful methods’ or ‘violence,’ Gordian made sure his followers respected every member of his family.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_LIMITED_EQUIP_6_.text: ดูราดูเหมือนไร้อารมณ์ใดๆ แต่การระบายอารมณ์หลังจากใช้เวลา 20,000 ปีอยู่คนเดียวนั้นช่างน่าอึดอัดใจ ดูราพยายามค้นหาคำศัพท์ที่เหมาะสมที่สุดในสถานการณ์ใดก็ตาม แต่ไม่สามารถอธิบายการแสดงออกขั้นสุดท้ายได้ชัดเจน เนื่องจากพฤติกรรมที่เผชิญหน้าโป๊กเกอร์ ไม่มีใครรับรู้ถึงการเปลี่ยนแปลงที่เกิดขึ้นใน Nebula

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_LIMITED_TRADE_6_.text: แม้จะสูญเสียความทรงจำส่วนใหญ่ของเธอ Livea ก็ยังตระหนักถึงตัวเองว่าเป็นสิ่งที่โดดเดี่ยวและเป็นสิ่งที่น่าภาคภูมิใจ การถือพลังที่ไม่สามารถวัดได้กระดูกที่ทนทานเรียกโดย Livea จากความว่างเปล่าเป็นกระดูกของเธอเอง อย่างไรก็ตามร่างกายปัจจุบันของ Livea ที่แยกออกจากร่างกายหลักของเธอนั้นเปราะบางเหมือนกับร่างกายมนุษย์ธรรมดาดังนั้นมันจึงได้รับบาดเจ็บจากการสะดุดและตีวัตถุได้อย่างง่ายดาย

Nothing “triggered” her obsession with money. She has loved money for as long as she can remember. She was just born that way. Poor childhood? The fact that she didn’t know where her parents were and where her hometown was didn't bother her much. Rather, she used it as a way to make people pity her so that she could make more money. 

The part-time delivery job at Pumpkin City was a means to finance the sale of pumpkin stakes. When she witnessed the talent of her colleague ‘Iris’, she saw that as a way to make larger profits, and of course she didn’t miss the chance. The success of ‘Rainbow Delivery’ led to a series of huge investments, and she finally got her hands on the money she wanted. ‘Goodbye Pumpkin City.’ She took everything and left for ‘Devil Island’, a secluded island in Hasla. There, she would be called by her third alias, ‘Mammon’.

She came to Devil Island for one reason: to find out where her roots were. She could infer, by things only she could know, that her roots belonged to Devil Island. Her magical power that lures others - it must be a magical ability unique to the Demons. The ability grew much stronger in her hometown than when she was in Pumpkin City.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_UNIQUE_6_PRYDWEN.text: At a glance, you might assume that Prydwen is just throwing in random ingredients for her bombs. But in actuality, Prydwen is very precise and calculative when crafting her wild creations. Her talent goes beyond just crafting bombs. By cooking with the perfect temperature, Prydwen’s Chen-styled skewered chicken is known to taste better than the ones you can find locally in Chen. But despite her fantastic cooking skills, she often eats alone as she has no real friends.

TEXT_RARE_SET_MAG_DEF_EP5_STONE_1_DESC.text: ช็อคโกแลตฟองดองของใครบางคนบังเอิญตกลงไปในปล่องภูเขาไฟ ใครก็ตามที่กัดจะได้ลิ้มรสความหวานที่แผดเผาของนรก

TEXT_RARE_SET_MAG_SP_EP5_STONE_1_DESC.text: กรงเล็บหลุดออกจากขาหน้าอันว่องไวของซาลาแมนเดอร์ ยังมีคราบเลือดและก้อนเนื้ออยู่ที่ปลายกรงเล็บ

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHY_ATK_EP5_STONE_1_DESC.text: คำพิพากษาเป็นลายลักษณ์อักษรระบุบุญในชีวิตและปล่อยให้ผู้รับไม่ต้องรับโทษจากนรกในชีวิตหลังความตาย เกณฑ์คุณสมบัติสูงมากซึ่งมีเพียงไม่กี่คนเท่านั้นที่เข้าร่วมที่นี่

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHY_ATK_EP5_STONE_2_DESC.text: ลูกศรหักที่ใช้โดยสมาชิกของ Chrona Heroes การต่อสู้ที่ดุเดือดควรจะเกิดขึ้นในพื้นที่ที่ถูกพบ

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHY_DEF_EP5_STONE_1_DESC.text: มีข่าวลือว่านี่คือน้ำตาที่แข็งตัวของเทพธิดา Hasla หลายคนบอกว่าการอมปากจะช่วยลดอาการคลื่นไส้ที่เกิดจากความร้อนได้

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHY_SP_EP5_STONE_2_DESC.text: อาวุธโบราณที่แกะสลักอย่างประณีตด้วยหินออบซิเดียน เป็นเรื่องที่น่าประหลาดใจที่อาวุธที่ทำจากวัสดุที่อ่อนนุ่มสามารถอยู่รอดได้นานโดยไม่มีความเสียหาย
