Master Umrat was kidnapped by the demon.
 Think about the hardship she had to endure!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_4_7_05.text:
Master Umrat. Forgive me. To apologize,
 I will never leave you from now on...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_4_7_06.text: You would do that? I'm glad...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_4_7_08.text:
I'll be away.
 Call me when you're done.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_4_8_02.text:
It hurts...
 Mar, what are you doing?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_4_8_03.text:
She had everyone worried.
 How can she be complaining about being lonely!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_4_8_04.text: A little noogie won't hurt her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_4_8_08.text:
But!!! Why are you letting this slide, master?
 I shall break her wrist for harming... Urgh!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_4_8_09.text: ... Stop it! Can't you read the room?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_4_9_01.text:
Mar... They must have grown closer
 during the little time they had. She looks happy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_4_9_02.text: ... That scene gives me a chill.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_4_9_03.text:
Umrat has been a monster in apposition with the
 Yellow Emperor until just now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_4_9_04.text:
But now she's 'pretending' to be
 all girly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_4_9_05.text:
It's a good thing. She won't be destroying Hasla
 as long as she's playing that part.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_4_9_06.text:
What about you?
 Are you going back to Arart?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_4_9_07.text:
Mm... In fact, We're going to see the #Black Nun# and
 the #Kid Devil# to whom we owe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_4_9_08.text:
After that... We might even play the family
 just like what they're doing now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_4_9_09.text:
... But when I'm with them, the dark magic
 undermines my body.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_4_9_10.text:
Ahem... You should thank the big sisters
 for offering to take care of you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_4_9_12.text:
... As long as Necron is alive,
 my journey of vengeance doesn't end.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_4_9_13.text:
But… I won't be lonely.
 I've decided to face the demon in my arm.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_4_9_14.text:
Wow, whenever you need help,
 call me at the Hero Town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_4_9_16.text:
Oh, you guys go ahead.
 I have to ask {PLAYER_NAME} something...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_1_02.text: Why are you repeating this cruelty?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_1_03.text:
... You followed me all the way here?
 You're pretty tough for leftover food.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_1_04.text:
Holding your tenacity in high regard,
 I will generously give you an answer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_1_05.text:
I'm doing this to gain the #Yonder Knowledge#
 so that I can figure out the truth about this world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_1_07.text:
You didn't know? I guess #Cyclops# on your arm
 never told you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_1_08.text:
Demons are summoned here from another
 dimension through contract.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_1_09.text:
Those monsters seem irrational, but that's because
 they were affected by the dimensional cross.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_1_10.text:
When you make more offerings
 of a better quality, their senses become

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_1_11.text:
clearer. They will grant you with knowledge
 never accessible in Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_1_12.text:
Sacrificing only a few useless humans for that
 is quite a great deal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_1_13.text:
How dare you judge human value!
 You're a demon yourself! I will stop you now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_2_01.text:
It's too late.
 The magic circle for summoning ritual is complete.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_2_02.text:
Finally...
 The #Yellow Emperor# arrives from beyond.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_3_01.text:
Huh? The village is that way...
 but I don't want to get any closer...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_3_03.text:
I think it's something more serious than
 quakes or monsters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_3_05.text:
It's because you're a human and old.
 A non-human race might even faint now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_3_06.text:
Yes. It feels like I'm getting stabbed
 with needles all over my skin.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_3_07.text:
I'm powerless now but the one
 from beyond is much stronger than me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_3_08.text:
That cannot be true! Nothing is greater than
 Master Umrat!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_3_09.text:
Hey, you tattered mutt. Can't you see that?
 Are you blind or something?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_3_10.text:
I know we're fanatics but...
 we're not a moth to the flame.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_3_11.text: Blasphemy! How can you even say that?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_3_12.text:
Calm down, people.
 How can you be fighting at a time like this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_4_01.text:
Strange...
 This energy feels familiar for some reason.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_4_02.text:
Even more so than you
 whom have been created using my own energy...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_5_01.text:
Is that so?
 But that energy is...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_5_02.text:
How can you find that chaotic energy to be familiar...
 I knew Umrat was evil...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_5_03.text:
Hey, shut up!
 To lose faith is...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_6_01.text:
She's dead!
 Her heart is not beating!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_6_03.text:
Oh, right.
 Human heart is on the left side, isn't it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_6_04.text:
Let's see... Oh, my mistake.
 She's alive!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_6_07.text:
Oh, are you awake now?
 Who are you, and what happened?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_6_08.text:
Uh... Hmm?
 W-who are you to be here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_6_09.text:
It's dangerous here!
 You must escape... Argh!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_6_10.text:
Don't move! You're badly hurt.
 We need to treat her first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_6_11.text:
There is no time.
 You must get away from the Naga village...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_6_12.text:
Excuse me? Our village?
 Can you tell me what happened?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_6_13.text:
Naga? Ah... So you are Seiren.
 Let's get moving for now. I'll tell you on the...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_7_01.text: Um... It's coming from over there!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_1_7_03.text: the notorious Lilith, the Goddess of Night!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_10_01.text: ... Altar of Offerings... Is it too late?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_10_02.text:
They sacrificed the deep-sea Nagas to open the #door#.
 There's also a human on the floor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_10_03.text:
A human? That is not.
 I feel something evil about her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_10_04.text:
You call me evil oftentimes.
 It's obvious she's been... infected up to her arm.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_10_05.text: Is she alive though? Let's see...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_11_03.text:
So the rumor about summoning otherworldly entities
 was true.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_11_04.text:
Magic has filled up this space...
 Is it coming from the hole of that void?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_11_06.text:
You can tell it's a dimensional rift
 created with dark magic, but you can't

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_11_07.text:
feel the Dark energy except the
 energy coming from that demon...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_11_09.text: Yes. And it's getting stronger... Huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_11_10.text:
Watch out, all of you! Something's coming
 from beyond the rift!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_12_02.text:
How strange. Thought I might find something dark enough
 to be turned into an offering. {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_12_03.text: What's a goddess' dog doing in this odd place?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_12_04.text: Soul Magician... You know about us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_13_01.text:
Of course. Hypocrites with absolute power,
 who tend to destroy anything they don't like.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_13_02.text:
My pleasure to meet you. I'm #Necron#,
 the only seeker of truth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_13_04.text:
I'm rather humble compared to those who call themselves
 god just because they have some petty abilities.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_13_05.text:
Wow, the subjects for the Artificial Goddess experiment?
 I see where this is going.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_13_06.text:
#One-Eyed Kalard# must have sent you to get in my way,
 saying how it is for this world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_13_07.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. You seem quite indecisive
 for a Champion of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_13_08.text:
Even if Arart is up to something,
 you can't deny the summoning of other beings.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_13_09.text:
You created innocent victims in the process,
 and that gives us a reason to stop you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_13_10.text: Hmm. Elard from the deep sea...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_13_11.text:
You still hold preconceived notions of light and darkness
 when Cora has betrayed you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_13_12.text:
... I wonder if you could say the same thing
 when you're faced with the truth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_14_02.text:
The opposite side of the rift...
 The #territory#...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_14_03.text:
Fools must see it to believe it,
 so I decided to show you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_1_01.text:
What is it, Haerang?
 You seem troubled.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_1_02.text:
Do I? Okay, let me tell you...
 I still haven't heard from Mar's group.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_1_03.text:
I'm worried they might be in
 big trouble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_1_04.text: Umrat is with them, so don't worry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_1_05.text:
To be honest... Unless it's {PLAYER_NAME},
 nobody can even put a finger on him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_1_06.text:
But I recently heard some unsettling rumors from owners
 of the mountains connected to the offshoots.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_1_07.text:
They say other beings such as 'Jang San Beom'
 have been crossing the dimension to get here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_1_08.text:
If the offshoots get weakened
 and if extraterrestrial beings come to invade us,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_1_09.text:
places that went through confusion due to weakened
 offshoots could be their target.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_1_11.text: Should I go and check now...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_1_12.text:
Were you about to head out to the 'Mystical Seas'?
 So I came all the way here for nothing then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_1_13.text:
But you don't seem to know what
 you might run into over there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_2_01.text:
Hello, {PLAYER_NAME}
 and the followers of the false god.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_2_02.text:
I'm Fredrick and this is Francesca,
 my little sister.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_2_03.text:
... Followers of the false what?
 How rude you are!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_2_04.text:
Fredrick, you said you would stop
 talking about false whatever.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_2_05.text:
... Oh, it's just that
 old habits die hard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_2_06.text:
I thought I was no longer
 brainwashed...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_2_07.text:
And don't call me your
 LITTLE sister. I'm the older one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_2_09.text:
Enough with your family business.
 Did you say you were Fredrick and Francesca?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_2_10.text:
Are you from the Order of the Goddess?
 What business do you have with {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_2_11.text: I'm sorry if I was being rude. Forgive me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_2_12.text:
We came here to deliver her message,
 and to help you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_3_01.text:
Who is she supposed to be?
 I have no friends in the Order of the Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_3_03.text:
We follow
 #Arart#, the Goddess of Judgment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_3_04.text:
She is the seeker of truth who will spread the
 true gospel among little lambs of this world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_3_05.text:
Goddess of Judgment...
 She's the traitor who used to be Bella's teacher.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_3_06.text:
I heard she's recently stopped by {PLAYER_NAME}
 while plotting a scheme in the Neth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_3_07.text:
A scheme... I guess you can think that way
 if you can't understand her true intention.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_3_08.text: Why don't you read the letter first?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_4_02.text:
You not only thwarted my plan but also
 took down Gullveig...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_4_03.text:
Thanks to you, I've been keeping myself busy
 trying to evade the executioner.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_4_05.text:
I'm sending you this letter
 because I have to ask you a favor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_4_06.text:
Considering the resentment built up so far,
 you would probably ignore this letter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_4_07.text: But just hear me out though.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_4_08.text:
For decades, Kalard has been weakening the
 offshoots of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_4_09.text:
The purpose was to contain #Habaek#,
 the ancient secret being.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_4_10.text:
But in the process, we ended up waking up something
 that was sleeping somewhere in the deep sea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_4_12.text:
He is the pure darkness
 who is never to be allowed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_4_13.text:
The fact that he's awake
 is already a headache but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_4_14.text:
Lately, we've been sensing dimensional quakes
 somewhere in the Mystical Seas.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_4_15.text:
A #soul magician# has been using Umrat's energy
 to invoke an evil god from another dimension.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_4_16.text:
I'm not sure how he acquired knowledge
 of a different dimension but

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_4_17.text:
it would be a waste of time to agonize over
 what's already happened.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_4_18.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. What I'm asking you
 is to stop the summoning of the evil god.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_4_19.text:
Other Kalards won't
 interrupt us in this matter

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_4_20.text:
as they are most afraid of being
 possessed by dark energy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_4_21.text:
They'd rather watch Hasla being destroyed
 and turning back into nothing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_4_22.text:
... But I'm different from them.
 I will do anything to protect this land.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_4_23.text:
In that sense... I'll let the messengers
 to become your assistants.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_4_24.text:
Containers of pure light and darkness...
 The results of the 'Artificial Goddess' plan...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_4_25.text:
The archbishops from the Order regarded them
 as a failure, but they are perfect for this task.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_4_26.text:
Anyways... That is all I can say.
 I await your wise decision.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_5_01.text:
I saw Arart's research journal.
 And I confirm this is her writing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_5_02.text:
But then… We can't act on
 what's written in this letter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_5_03.text:
Even if what she said about the evil god is true...
 There's no guarantee this will not be a trap.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_5_04.text:
A trap? No way... Arart would never
 set you up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_5_05.text:
Yeah? She pretended to be dead to carry out
 horrible experiments for a hundred years.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_5_06.text:
As the result, the 'artificial goddesses', such as
 Avenir, Ellie, and you, were born...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_5_07.text:
Now I must wonder why you are
 so fond of Arart.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_5_08.text:
Hm, I didn't know anything about that.
 So Arart was a baddie?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_5_09.text: Then the letter could be a lure.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_6_01.text:
Oh, you buy that?
 Are you playing fool or actually a fool? Tsk...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_6_02.text: So {PLAYER_NAME}, did you make up your mind?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_7_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}... You're going to follow them?
 It's too risky!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_7_02.text:
Haerang is right, {PLAYER_NAME}.
 There should be at least some proof...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_7_04.text:
It's quite natural
 for us to have doubts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_7_05.text:
You should know by now Arart is on a different path
 than that of the other Kalards.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_7_06.text:
No matter what happened in the past...
 It would be worth it to at least reconsider it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_7_08.text:
Anyways, follow us when you're done talking.
 We'll be there first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_8_02.text: She must be up to something.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_8_04.text:
There have been rumors about
 extraplanar beings, remember?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_8_05.text:
If they are really preparing to summon the evil god,
 those could be the sign.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_9_01.text:
... It's true.
 We have no choice but to see it for ourselves.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_9_02.text:
Just look at {PLAYER_NAME}'s face.
 Looks so determined to me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_9_03.text:
Well, Then I'll report this to Habaek,
 who is in his palace, and ask for help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_9_04.text:
Okay. If bringing in something from another world has
 affected the offshoots,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_9_05.text:
Habaek also must have been affected as well.
 You should stay with him, since you're his oracle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_2_9_06.text:
Then we'll follow the twins.
 Let us know if something comes up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_1_01.text:
How fortunate. I couldn't use the power of goddess
 after entering this space but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_1_02.text: I guess he wasn't all that powerful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_1_04.text:
Our attack didn't seem to work but...
 I still don't understand how we defeated him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_1_05.text:
Who cares.
 We took care of him, and that's what matters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_1_06.text:
Now... Shall we take this Soul Magician to
 Arart now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_1_07.text:
Don't be so rash.
 Did you think you defeated him?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_2_02.text:
But how?
 I saw him going down...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_2_03.text:
The Yellow Emperor is a superior being.
 What you saw was only a silhouette...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_2_04.text:
Creatures from the physical dimension
 cannot capture his nature.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_2_05.text:
But I'm different because I made an offer to devil
 to acquire the knowledge of another world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_2_06.text:
So is that your truth? That you befriended a
 higher form of life?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_2_07.text:
I already knew the world outside of Hasla
 were full of monsters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_2_08.text: And that not all of the dark creatures were evil...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_2_09.text:
It accepts human sacrifice and receives order from the
 likes of you. Of course it's evil!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_2_10.text:
Hah... Have ignorant people of Hasla been
 worshipping these fools as their heroes?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_2_11.text:
I was a fool for thinking something would be different.
 Why even bother talking...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_2_12.text: Yellow Emperor... Your faithful servant begs of you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_2_13.text:
Vanish those foolish creatures
 from this holy space.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_3_02.text:
Fredrick! I was going to block it...
 Are you alright?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_3_03.text:
... Oho- You stopped the blow..
 So you're no ordinary subject.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_3_04.text:
Did they mix the energy of two people,
 to separate the discordant magics?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_3_05.text:
Indeed... When the polar-opposite magics are
 suddenly combined... Wow, Hmm...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_3_07.text:
I don't know what's going on but...
 Let's escape while he's distracted.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_3_08.text: But... How do we escape from this space?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_3_09.text: Don't worry. I'll open up the door for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_4_01.text: What is the meaning of this, Lilith?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_4_02.text:
Hey, you wanted them to vanish from this space,
 so I just chose the easier and faster way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_4_03.text:
That's nonsense...
 I was about to win.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_4_04.text:
Don't tell me you're suddenly scared of
 fighting the Champions of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_4_05.text: You can never be too careful, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_4_06.text:
Even if the Yellow Emperor is in your control...
 its power isn't yours.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_4_07.text:
Until the #deal# is over,
 you'd better be careful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_4_08.text:
... Okay. I'll let you slide this time.
 But if you get in my way ever again...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_4_09.text:
Relax. You need to learn how to interact with
 humans first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_4_11.text:
*Sigh* Letting this old lady do all the work,
 those youngsters these days are...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_5_01.text:
! The power has returned...
 But where am I?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_5_02.text:
It's outside of the rift.
 At least we are out of the territory but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_5_03.text:
Considering what's happening in this area,
 I think the dimensional corrosion has occurred.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_5_04.text:
The foreign energy of the Yellow Emperor
 is flowing in through that rift.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_5_05.text: All of Hasla could turn into a space we were in earlier.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_6_01.text:
We have no choice but to defeat Necron
 in order to stop the ritual.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_6_02.text:
... Then we must re-enter the
 territory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_6_03.text:
How are we supposed to evade the
 never-dying monsters before striking Necron?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_6_04.text:
Nothing comes to mind for now.
 We have no choice but to go head on.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_6_06.text:
Fredrick and I will go with {PLAYER_NAME}
 to the territory to contain the Yellow Emperor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_6_07.text:
Meanwhile, you must find a 'way'.
 Necron must have left a clue somewhere.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_6_09.text:
Before I was dragged into the beyond,
 I saw a woman lying down next to the altar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_6_10.text:
She was alive, but her arm had been corroded.
 She might know something.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_6_11.text:
Necron also said he had acquired knowledge of
 another world from a demon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_7_01.text:
... Fine. I'll find the altar
 as soon as possible.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_7_02.text:
Be careful. Now that dimensional corrosion is happening,
 we don't know what to expect anymore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_7_03.text: Wait, why didn't you mention that earlier...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TOTALWAR_START_3_8_01.text:
... It feels like we're being
 swayed by those kids.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCESSORY_1_02.text:
Huh? You have something I’ve never seen before.
Looks like only ★6 warriors can wear it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCESSORY_1_03.text:
What? That's from another dimension?
W-wait. Let me see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCESSORY_1_04.text:
... Hm, impressive. It holds overwhelming power.
But... It has the potential to become even better.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCESSORY_1_05.text: Leave it to me. I'll make a better one out of that. What do you say?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCESSORY_2_01.text: Like a ring, you can press 'Convert’ to #convert# its options.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCESSORY_2_02.text:
But... There is a fixed option that never changes.
It's also difficult to convert only one option.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCESSORY_2_03.text:
So, pressing ‘Convert’ arbitrarily converts
all options except the #fixed option#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCESSORY_2_04.text:
That's so much I can do, as it is an otherworldly thing.
It is beyond my control.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCESSORY_2_05.text:
And... as its many options are so complex,
I'll use an easy to read symbols.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCESSORY_2_06.text:
Press ‘Tome’ to learn more about
all options available from conversion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCESSORY_2_07.text:
Mss. Celine and Pan... ...something should have
prepared a book of options.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCESSORY_2_08.text:
I'm too old to read anything too long.
Be my guest as it's your to read.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCESSORY_3_01.text:
Oh, it'll be more useful
if you #enhance# the accessory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCESSORY_3_02.text:
Please ask me separately as this requires
a different process from #conversion#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCESSORY_3_03.text:
And... This might hurt my reputation,
but, as a smith, I must admit that...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCESSORY_3_05.text:
But who am I?
Fugus, the best smith in Hasla!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCESSORY_3_06.text:
Failure is the mother of success!
Even if I continued to fail, I will succeed one day!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCESSORY_3_07.text:
Expect a dramatic improvement in performance.
I promise.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCESSORY_3_08.text:
But #conversion# isn't possible
after a successful #enhancement#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCESSORY_4_01.text:
Last but not least, you need #antimatter#
for #conversion# and #enhancement#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCESSORY_4_02.text:
Where can you get it? Why ask me?
You are the adventurer, aren't you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCESSORY_4_03.text:
Well... If you have no idea, salvage this accessory
as it is also made of #antimatter#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCESSORY_4_04.text:
That’s about it.
Drop by anytime when you need help!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_1_1.text:
The auction has begun!
Many have gathered to see the treasures!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_1_2.text:
In an auction, only the winners claim the prize!
But don’t worry, you don’t have to be rich to win!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_1_3.text:
This is an event for everyone!
We have plenty of antiques from the orchard!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_1_4.text:
The Hasla Auction is for every #hardworking# captain!
It features a #ranking system#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_1_5.text:
But don’t think for a second that it’s free!
There’s a good reason why I mentioned #hardworking#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_1_6.text: Now then, let me explain to you how the auction works.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_1_7.text: First, tap ‘Participate’ and enter the auction!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_2_1.text: There are two types of auctions: Normal and Special.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_2_2.text: Normal Auctions show your rank. Special Auctions do not.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_2_3.text:
Each turn is 2 hours long,
and you can’t bid during the final 5 minutes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_2_4.text:
So realistically, you have 1 hour and 55 minutes to bid!
Take caution when participating in the auction!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_2_5.text:
Even if you have a ton of money,
we can’t accept your bid if the turn is ending!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_3_1.text: This is the Auction Progress Panel.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_3_2.text:
Since the auctions are run on a #ranking system#,
#Minimum for Winning Bid# is extremely important.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_3_3.text: There is only 1 winner in an ordinary auction.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_3_4.text:
But here in the Ranking Auction, as long as you bid above
the #Minimum for Winning Bid#, you can win!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_3_5.text:
If your Bidding Rank is #above# the Minimum,
the sign at the bottom will show an ‘O.’

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_3_6.text: If it’s lower, the sign will display an ‘X.’

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_3_7.text: And the Minimum Winning Bid #changes every turn#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_4_1.text: You can see what items are being auctioned off here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_5_1.text: If you want to bid on an item, enter a price here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_5_2.text: You can only bid a certain number of times each turn!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_5_3.text:
And REMEMBER! You can always increase your bid,
but you cannot #lower or cancel# it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_6_1.text: Now, let me tell you about the ‘Schedule’ tab.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_7_1.text:
You can check the Auction Schedule here
through the #Schedule# tab during the event period.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_7_2.text: It’s important to plan your schedule ahead of time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_7_3.text:
Saving your bidding tickets to get the item you want
is also a great plan!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_8_1.text: This here is the previous winning bid history.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_8_2.text:
It could be useful to you if you are trying to
find the market value of a certain item.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_8_3.text: If you have any more questions, use the ‘Help’ button!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_8_4.text:
I will provide you with more detailed information
regarding the Auction Rules and Tokens!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_AUCTION_8_5.text:
Then I’ll be seeing you!
Good luck!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_ROGUELIKE_1_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME},
you’ve successfully finished your first battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_ROGUELIKE_1_02.text:
This Tower definitely 
has very unstable magic powers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_ROGUELIKE_1_03.text:
But the good thing is that...
we can use them to our advantage.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_ROGUELIKE_1_04.text: I believe we can use the unstable powers

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_ROGUELIKE_1_06.text:
{PLAYER_NAME},
did you feel that you could control your skills?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_ROGUELIKE_1_07.text: Let’s check the power you just gained.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_ROGUELIKE_2_1_.text: Can you press the Status Window button?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_ROGUELIKE_2_2_.text:
You can check the magic powers
you've acquired up to this point.

you have to choose
between two magic powers.

The magic power you choose
takes effect from the next battle.

And the powers you choose
get #stacked# without disappearing.
However, when you go back to the first floor

#all the magic powers acquired disappear#
because you're no longer in the range.

When you’ve mistakenly stacked the wrong powers,
it might be a good idea to go back to the start.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_ROGUELIKE_2_3_.text:
Next, let me tell you the growth strategies
that can help you with the Pantheon battles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_ROGUELIKE_2_4_.text:
Did you notice that you acquire +1 Pantheon Point
every time you win a battle?

You can use some of these points
to upgrade the level of your class.

Every time the level of a class goes up,
the hero's stats get enhanced.

Remember that these levels are available
in the Pantheon only.

Unlike magic powers, levels are
#not reset upon your team's elimination.#

It may be a good idea to grow the occupations
that you wish to use frequently.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_ROGUELIKE_2_6_.text:
Clicking on the Start Again button
will take you back to the Tower’s first floor.

Remember that your magic powers, floors, and team
will all be reset.

If you feel that your strategies need to be fixed,
it might be a better idea to return to Floor 1.

If you wish to continue going upward,
you can click the Continue button.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_ROGUELIKE_2_7_.text:
Click on the Quests and Achievements buttons
to see the different Expedition missions.

The Empire will reward you
every time you clear a mission.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_ROGUELIKE_2_8_.text:
The Pantheon Coins you acquire
with every battle you win

can be used to heal incapacitated members
or to be exchanged for rewards at the stores.
Use them as you see fit.
That’s all the instructions you need for now...

Please,
make the Expedition a success.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_ROGUELIKE_INTR.text:
Are you ready, {PLAYER_NAME}? 
Please form your Expedition here.
Your team cannot be reformed unless it is wiped out.

When it is wiped out,
a new party must be formed #on the first floor#.

The number of allies in your team is limited initially,
but as you progress, more heroes will join you.

When your team is wiped out,
continue going up with new allies and strategies.

When your team member dies during battle,
you can’t use them on the next floors.

You need to continue fighting
without the incapacitated hero.

Unless all heroes are wiped out,
you can revive them using Pantheon Coins
The Tower’s magic powers might have an effect on them.

This won’t be like
the other battles you’ve fought.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_1_1.text: ขอบคุณสำหรับวันนี้. นี่คือค่าใช้จ่ายสำหรับการเดินทางของคุณ

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_1_2.text: ฮ่าฮ่าขอบคุณ. เราหวังว่าจะทำธุรกิจกับคุณต่อไป

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_2_1.text: ฉันจะออกไปตอนนี้

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_2_2.text:
ใช่อยู่อย่างปลอดภัย ...
... อะไรทำให้คุณมาที่นี่ {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_2_3.text: ฮะ? คุณพบว่านักขี่ม้าสงสัย?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_2_4.text:
แม้ว่าเขาจะแวะเวียนไปที่นี่มาก
คุณจำเขาไม่ได้เหรอ?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_2_5.text:
มาเร็ว.
ฉันเป็นประจำที่นี่ดังนั้นความสงสัยของคุณทำให้ฉันเจ็บ

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_3_1.text:
คุณคิดว่าเขาจะช้ากว่าปกติหรือไม่?
ราวกับว่าการสำรวจสถานที่นี้?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_3_10.text:
นั่นจะไม่เป็นปัญหา ไม่มีฮีโร่
จะขัดกับสิ่งที่ {PLAYER_NAME} พูด

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_3_11.text: ว้าวน่าประทับใจ

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_3_12.text:
ฮีโร่ให้ความไว้วางใจในตัวคุณอย่างแท้จริง
คุณเป็นผู้นำที่มีชื่อเสียงอย่างแท้จริงใน Hasla ใช่ไหม?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_3_2.text:
นั่นคือความจริงนักขี่ม้ามักจะ
ขนถ่ายสินค้าอย่างรวดเร็วจากนั้นก็รีบออกไป

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_3_3.text:
วันนี้ฉันไม่ยุ่งขนาดนั้น
และเป็นที่น่าชื่นชมที่ได้เห็นฮีโร่ที่มีประสบการณ์ที่นี่

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_3_4.text: อืม ... ช่างพูดมากกว่าปกติ

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_3_5.text:
โดยปกติจะเป็นเหมือน
"ฉันยุ่งทันกับคุณในภายหลัง"

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_3_6.text:
ความสงสัยที่ไม่มีเหตุผล
มองฉันสิ. ไม่รู้จักใบหน้าของฉัน?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_3_7.text: ใช่ แต่ก็ยัง ฉันไว้วางใจสัญชาตญาณของ {player_name}

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_3_8.text: ความสงสัยดังกล่าวของฉันจะทำให้ความไว้วางใจของเรา

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_3_9.text: ความสัมพันธ์ที่ไม่ดีกับฉันเป็นเพียงข้อเสียสำหรับคุณ

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_4_1.text:
นี่เป็นการแนะนำตัวเองอย่างฉับพลันก่อนวัยอันควร
แต่ฉันเรียกว่า Horseman Scouter

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_4_2.text:
Scouter!? นักเดินทางระหว่างมิตินอกเหนือจาก Hasla
คุณเป็นนักขี่ม้าในตำนาน?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_4_3.text:
อย่าเชื่อนิทานสูงทั้งหมดที่คุณได้ยิน
ฉันเพิ่งจะเสียน้อยลงด้วยเท้าที่เบากว่า

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_4_4.text: แล้วเกิดอะไรขึ้นกับนักขี่ม้าดั้งเดิม?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_4_5.text:
ไม่จำเป็นต้องกังวล เราเป็นเพื่อนร่วมงาน
ฉันแค่ยืมเกวียนนี้ในช่วงเวลานี้

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_4_6.text: เหมือนฝาแฝดมากกว่าเพื่อนร่วมงานถ้าคุณถามฉัน ...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_4_7.text:
อานี่เป็นเพียงการปลอมตัว
ธุรกิจที่อันตรายเรียกร้องให้มีการปลอมตัวที่เหมาะสม

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_4_8.text: รูปแบบที่แท้จริงของฉันคือหญิงสาวที่น่าดึงดูดใจที่สวยงาม

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_4_9.text: นั่นไม่ใช่ความกังวลของฉัน อะไรทำให้คุณมาที่นี่?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_5_1.text: ฉันได้ยินว่าฮีโร่จำนวนมากมาภายใต้การนำของคุณ

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_5_2.text: ดังนั้นฉันแค่อยากเห็นพวกเขาด้วยตัวเอง

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_5_3.text: ข่าวลือมาถึงคุณเร็วกว่าที่เราคิด

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_5_4.text: ตอนนี้คุณได้เห็นเราความประทับใจของคุณคืออะไร?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_5_5.text: คุณทุกคนผ่านไปด้วยสีสันการบิน

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_5_6.text:
แม้อย่างรวดเร็วฉันสังเกตเห็นทหารผ่านศึกที่มีประสบการณ์หลายคน
น่าประหลาดใจภายใต้การควบคุมโดยไม่มีความขัดแย้ง

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_5_7.text:
ต้องขอบคุณผู้นำด้วยตาที่ดี
ฉันจะไม่ระงับการสรรเสริญ

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_5_8.text: ว้าวที่ได้รับการยอมรับจากตำนานที่ยอดเยี่ยมมาก

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_5_9.text: ตอนนี้ทุกอย่างอยู่บนโต๊ะมาคุยกันเรื่องธุรกิจกันเถอะ

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_6_1.text:
เท่าที่คุณมีฮีโร่ที่มีชื่อเสียง
ฉันยังมีฮีโร่พร้อมที่จะพิสูจน์ตัวเอง

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_6_10.text: จากนั้นคุณหมายถึง ...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_6_11.text: ฉันต้องการคนที่ดีที่สุดที่สามารถต่อสู้ในแนวหน้า

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_6_12.text:
และในทางกลับกันฉันเสนอให้คุณ
ฮีโร่เต็มใจที่จะต่อสู้เพื่อกลุ่มฮีโร่ของคุณ

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_6_13.text:
นั่นเป็นเรื่องผิดปกติ! ซื้อขายหนึ่งรายการ?
แน่นอนว่ามันจะต้องเสียค่าใช้จ่ายในการป้องกันของเรา

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_6_14.text: หากคุณจะทำอันตรายให้ลืมมัน

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_6_15.text:
แค่จำไว้ว่า
ฉันเดินทางไปทั่วโลก

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_6_16.text:
ฉันพบความสามารถที่ยอดเยี่ยมจากมุมที่ไกลที่สุด
ฉันรับรองว่าฉันสามารถเสนอพรสวรรค์ที่ไม่น่าเชื่อให้คุณได้

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_6_17.text: นี่เป็นโอกาสที่คุณไม่ควรพลาด คุณคิดอย่างไร?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_6_18.text: อืม ... เราควรทำอย่างไร {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_6_2.text:
ฮีโร่ผู้มีเกียรติพร้อมที่จะจางหายไปในประวัติศาสตร์
และฮีโร่ก็ใช้ใบมีดเพื่อเป็นเกียรติแก่

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_6_3.text: พวกเขาสามารถเปลี่ยนตำแหน่งในข้อตกลงร่วมกัน

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_6_4.text:
ดังนั้นการแลกเปลี่ยนความสามารถ
ฮีโร่ของเราจะไปที่ไหนเมื่อเราส่งพวกเขาออกไป?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_6_5.text:
ฉันสัญญาว่าจะผจญภัยที่มีค่าต่อฮีโร่ที่มีค่า
เพราะพวกเขาสามารถมองเห็นโลกที่ใหญ่กว่า

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_6_6.text: อืม ... ฉันเข้าใจว่าคุณหมายถึงอะไร

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_6_7.text:
ฮีโร่ของเราบางคนไม่มีประสบการณ์
เพื่อให้พวกเขาสามารถออกไปสัมผัสได้ ...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_6_8.text: ไม่ คุณเข้าใจผิดแล้ว ฉันไม่แสวงหาเศษผ้าที่ไม่เหมาะสม

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_6_9.text: คุณคิดว่าฉันกำลังเรียนโรงเรียนอนุบาล?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_7_1.text:
ดังนั้นคุณหมายความว่านี่เป็นโอกาสที่ควรค่าแก่การจับ
ฉันมีความเห็นเดียวกัน

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_7_2.text:
Scouter เราตัดสินใจแล้ว
เราหวังว่าจะได้ทำธุรกิจที่ดีกับคุณ

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_7_3.text:
ฮ่าฮ่านั่นเป็นเหมือนมันมากขึ้น
ฉันรู้ตั้งแต่เริ่มต้นว่าคุณเป็นคนที่ทะเยอทะยาน

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_HEROTRADE_ENTER_7_4.text:
ฉันจะส่งจดหมายรายละเอียดข้อกำหนดและเงื่อนไข
ฉันหวังว่าจะได้ทำธุรกิจที่ดีกับคุณทุกคน

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TOTALWAR_INGAME_1_01.text:
Welcome, {PLAYER_NAME}. 
 Did Fredrick show you around?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TOTALWAR_INGAME_1_02.text:
You see, avatars sent by #Yellow Emperor# 
 are too big and powerful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TOTALWAR_INGAME_2_01.text:
So focus on commanding, {PLAYER_NAME}. 
 Heroes will do the fighting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TOTALWAR_INGAME_2_02.text:
... Good. Now auto-battle will run on its own. 
 I'll teach you how to fight the emperor's avatars.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TOTALWAR_INGAME_3_01.text:
You see the timer? 
 You must defeat avatars before the timer goes off.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TOTALWAR_INGAME_3_02.text:
Avatars will wipe us out in no time if they 
 fully gather the power of their territories.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TOTALWAR_INGAME_4_01.text: If you can't defeat the boss within the time limit,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TOTALWAR_INGAME_4_02.text:
the battle will end with an alarm. 
 Keep that in mind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TOTALWAR_INGAME_5_01.text:
And... #Reinforcements Button#! Pressing this makes us 
 bring reinforcements to you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TOTALWAR_INGAME_5_02.text: But you can't use it anytime.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TOTALWAR_INGAME_5_03.text:
You must gather enough energy to summon us 
 from the outside of the territory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TOTALWAR_INGAME_5_04.text:
Damage dealt by the heroes in the battle and 
 the chain of the triggered skills fill up the gauge.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TOTALWAR_INGAME_5_05.text:
Mostly, Main Type heroes uses 3-chains while Support 
 Type heroes use 1-chain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TOTALWAR_INGAME_6_01.text:
The button is activated when the gauge is full. 
 That is when you can summon us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TOTALWAR_INGAME_6_02.text:
As long as the gauge is full, 
 you can press the Summon button anytime.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TOTALWAR_INGAME_6_03.text:
But remember the gauge starts 
 filling up again only after summoning is done.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TOTALWAR_INGAME_7_01.text:
Here you can check the avatar's #HP Info#. 
 Never let your guard down.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TOTALWAR_INGAME_7_02.text:
This is the emperor's territory. Whenever you win, 
 the difficulty level goes up with a stronger avatar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TOTALWAR_INGAME_7_03.text:
We must defeat as many avatars as possible to 
 stop #Yellow Emperor# from corroding the dimension.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TOTALWAR_INGAME_7_04.text:
Well, {PLAYER_NAME}. 
 This is as far as I can tell you. Hope you have fun.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TOTALWAR_OUTGAME_1_0.text:
... You came. The ritual has already begun. 
 Let's get ready to enter the dimensional rift.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TOTALWAR_OUTGAME_2_0.text:
You can adjust the #Total War Difficulty# here.
 The higher the difficulty, the stronger the avatar.

At first, only the #Difficulty: Hard# is available. 
 Play the previous difficulty to open the next.

Each difficulty provides treasures of a different grade. 
 Select the grade fit for {PLAYER_NAME}'s level.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TOTALWAR_OUTGAME_3_0.text:
Check the #Supporting Faction and Reinforcements Stats# 
 in here.

In the territory, the #bonded# hero 
 exerts more power.

The supporting faction changes every time because 
 staying in the territory can be demanding.

Independent heroes can help anytime, 
 but they can't be at their best.

Reinforcements heroes affect the entire reinforcements, 
 so be mindful of who you're choosing.

I'll tell you more about registering the reinforcements 
 from here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TOTALWAR_OUTGAME_4_0.text:
Here, you place the heroes to enter the dimensional rift.
 We must form #4# teams, each having 3 heroes.

If you don't complete 4 teams,
 you cannot enter the dimensional rift.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TOTALWAR_OUTGAME_5_0.text: Reinforcements can be consisted of 4★ heroes of yours.

You may register up to 16 heroes, but you can 
 still enter the dimensional rift with less.

Entering the dimensional rift requires many things, 
 so we support a few functions to help {PLAYER_NAME}.

Touch #Auto-Place# button here
 to place the most elite heroes first.

If you want to register the reinforcements manually,
 register them one at a time from the list.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TOTALWAR_OUTGAME_6_0.text:
Before entering the dimensional rift, 
 you can engage in a #battle training#.

But this is an unstable space created with magic, 
 so there is a limited number of attempts.
Press [Enter] button to enter the dimensional rift.

Since it is your first battle, #Francesca# will 
 help you inside the rift.
Then... Good luck, {PLAYER_NAME}. I'll join you soon.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_182_END.text:
Whew! Thanks for your help.
Honestly speaking, I couldn’t have done it alone.

...There’s still work to do. Despite being a small town,
trouble never stops finding its way here.
You have no idea how exhausted I am.

Whenever you’re out of town for a job,
I’m the one that manages the town!

And I couldn’t really complain,
because you’re a Hero of Hasla and all.

But since the world is so peaceful now,
I guess I’ll bug you more often!

As long as {player_name} is here in Hasla, it’ll be peaceful.
...And as long as you’re here, I’ll be by your side.

From the bottom of my heart.
Thank you, {player_name}.

And...
I hope to continue to work by your side.
Now, let’s go do some work, shall we?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_182_STA.text:
It’s been a while since we’ve first met.
Time sure goes by fast.

From fighting the Apostles to the Siege of Impelis...
Many things happened since then.

Do you also remember the Palace Ball?
We went through so much hardship.

Looking back now, your leadership was truly inspiring.
{player_name}, you were always a reliable leader to us.

There was a time when we had trouble keeping peace
even in this small town. It feels unreal now.

You’ve been extremely busy bringing peace to Hasla.
And even today, you’re busy preserving the peace.

Everyone still calls you for help. Hasla still needs you.
You’ve become an irreplaceable figure to us.

Since you aren’t too busy today, let’s take a walk
around town, shall we?

...The townspeople have been causing trouble.
Please help, {player_name}...

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_183_END.text:
How is it, {player_name}?
Did you spend a lot of money?

...This feels way too suspicious?
...They asked if Bridget led you here?

Although it’s true they signed a deal that said I get
a percentage of their revenue if I bring customers,

I didn’t lie.
It truly will bring a huge economic boom here in Hasla.

Fine... I guess I have no choice.
I won’t hide anything from you now, {player_name}.

I’m saving as much money as possible for my grand plan.
I’m getting ready for something truly spectacular.

The Bridget Shop is going to be rebuilt into
#Bridget Mart#! The biggest mart in Hasla!

And with the resources I’ve gathered, I can quickly
get construction underway! I’ll make a huge franchise!

Bridget Mart, Bridget Bakery, Bridget Atelier,
Bridget Tech, Bridget Delivery, and Bridget Town!

My ultimate goal is to leave behind a legacy.
A legacy that Hasla can’t go on without!

I would clash with the Hero Town merchants?
I’m sorry, but I don’t deal with traditional merchants.

But I’ve kind of grown fond of them now.
Perhaps I’ll hire them once I get going.

Oh, and you, {player_name}, will get VVIP Bridget Membership.
You will get 5% mileage on your purchases!

You are a regular at my shop! You also helped during
bingos and the auction! You deserve it!

Thank you for your patronage, {player_name}!
I’m always looking forward to working with you!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_183_STA.text:
Don’t you think it’s the perfect time to spend some gold?
{player_name}?

Let me finish talking!
I’m not asking you to spend gold at MY shop.

It’s been really peaceful lately, don’t you think?
Forget about the Apostles and Kalards!

Now that we’re at peace, the people of Hasla have been
spending more and more money!
You’ll see! The economy is going to skyrocket!

So, as the peacekeeper of Hasla, {player_name}, you should
be a role model and start spending a lot of money.

Support the local economy!
We need to revitalize the domestic market!

You think I have something up my sleeves, don’t you?
I, Bridget Pelancia, is famous for being a trustworthy merchant!

So have faith in me! And spend all your money!
It’ll benefit both of us, trust me.

How’s Fergus’ Blacksmith?
Celine’s Magic Laboratory?

{player_name}, your spending will greatly boost my-
I mean, Hasla’s economy for sure!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_184_END.text:
So how is it, {player_name}?
Do you feel your muscles warming up?

You won’t see any visual changes in just a day or two.
You’ll have to eat it consistently for a while!
Can I brag a little bit? Hehe

I made a deal with the Roman Gladiators.
They are in love with my bread!

They swear by it! Not only is it delicious, but it’s
very healthy for their body.

It used to be a tiny bakery left behind by my father.
It grew to what it is today thanks to you!

From the bottom of my heart, thank you {player_name}.
Leave all your baking needs to me!
I spoke with my father recently.

I was wondering what he was doing...
He’s apparently training to be a gladiator again.

He was worried his ‘warrior’ spirit is fading away.
So he took time to revitalize his spirit.

What he said made a lot of sense. His words inspired me.
You can’t do anything with a weak spirit!

Not only that, he actually had spies here in Hero Town!
He was checking on the bakery’s business all along.

Do you know who the spy was?
It was...

S-sorry, {player_name}!
I gotta get going! I’ll talk to you later!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_184_STA.text:
{player_name}!
I know it’s sudden, but let me bake you some bread!

I mean, I’m already baking for you,
but let me bake you something extra!

The thing is,
I invented a new type of bread!

It’ll be our new signature menu! “Muscle Bread!”
When you eat it, your muscles grow!

After the Doki Doki Bakery, I got Demeter’s recipes.
We decided to fully share our knowledge.

What? Did I use violence to get what I want?
What’re you talking about, haha...

She accepted my offer without hesitation!
Demeter discovered a genius business model.

The base of the bread is Demeter’s healthy bread.
I then added ingredients for muscular growth!

It’ll be effective without a doubt!
It’s way more effective than protein shakes!

The new bread boasts
both great flavor and healthy benefits!

Celine from next door smelled the bread and came running!
“This bread breaks the laws of physics!” she said.

So, {player_name}. Would you like to try some?
I’ll bake you the bread whenever you want!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_185_END.text:
Hahaha! Thank you for your help, {player_name}!
My greatest invention is now complete!

This is the pinnacle of Fergus technology!
High-End Fergusroid Flagship Model! #FUG9000#!

Haha, look how cute it is!
Isn’t it cool? Awesome, right?

It looks just like me, right? My dream was
to create a robot that looks exactly like me.

Look at its features! Handsome face with a nice stache!
Natural movements and muscles!

I can make him run errands to make my job easier!
I have a new project I have to work on.

I’ve accomplished my long-time dream of making a robot
that mirrors me. Now I have one thing left to do!

I did everything I can in Hasla.
It’s time to visit #another world# to hone my skills.

I can’t stay rooted in one place forever!
I heard of a broker that can send me to other worlds.

No time to delay! I should go look for her NOW!
I’m a man of initiative and drive!

Thank you for everything, {player_name}!
Please take care of my robot while I’m away!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_185_STA.text:
{player_name}, can you spare me some time?
I have something important to discuss with you.

The recent Scarecrow incident, Fergusroid incident,
and even the Ent Robot incident...

Looking back, we went through a lot, haven’t we?
And thinking about it now, it was all my fault...

Including you, many heroes fought against my creation.
Some heroes even got frustrated and angry at me.
But... all of these events got me thinking...

I was always impressed with myself.
But I think I’m even MORE impressive than that.

I used to be a simple blacksmith.
But now I’m making robots! My skills are evolving!

I also angered you... I can control emotions! Haha!
This whole town is practically under my grasp!
I’m starting to fear my own abilities at this point!

I sure accomplished a lot of things, don’t you think?
It was worth experimenting with you...
Ehem, nothing. Never mind what I said.

Anyways, I think I should aim even higher now.
I have an old dream.

{player_name}. I need Iron and Danan Fragments.
If you have any extra weapons, throw’em my way!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_186_END.text:
Thank you, {player_name}! I was able to gather data
thanks to you!

From comparing the new data to the old one,
Great Success seems to be completely based on luck.

It’s actually completely based on random luck.
The only entity that can affect it are B.Points.

How is this possible? It’s as if someone “programmed”
it like this. This cannot be natural.

Perhaps someone created this system...?
But if that’s the case... [mumbles]...
Wait...! What if Hasla itself is...!

No, there’s no way! Haha!
But still... it’s an interesting concept...

Some of the world’s greatest discoveries happened
from the silliest ideas, you know!

A genius is made with 1% hard work and 99% inspiration!
I should improve on this idea and expand my research!

I actually needed an idea for my thesis at the Magic
Academy. I think I can write a great paper with this!

But for that I still need to do a lot more research.
So I’m looking forward to working with you, {player_name}!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_186_STA.text:
Oh no, {player_name}!
I need your help with my research!

I’ve been transferring skills to your heroes for ages,
but there are still things I haven’t discovered yet!

Whenever I transfer skills, sometimes it ends
in Success and at other times Great Success!

I didn’t think much of it until recently!
What changes the results?

I always do the same thing each time.
So what causes Great Success?

What variable is there?
What causes that variable to affect the results?

And why is it that whenever you pay with Bridget Points,
the skill is guaranteed to end in Great Success?
There are so many questions that need answers!

Although I have a record of all the skill transfers,
I’ll need to go through them again.

I have to find what’s different! To be a successful
researcher, you need to doubt even the most ordinary!

Research has no end! We need to constantly renew data.
We are never satisfied with what we know...

Hey, are you listening? {player_name}?
Are you sleeping?

You are acting like Sera!
Is that narcolepsy contagious?
Hmm... interesting. I’ll research that later.

Anyways, we need to form a hypothesis!
Can you introduce me to heroes that need skills?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_187_END.text:
Thanks a bunch, {player_name}.
You and your heroes are the best!

You should see that fool working.
He works like someone who never done labor before.

What?! Go and do your job.
I’m talking with {player_name} here.

We’re running low on balloons...
Huh? {player_name}? Long time no see.

Long time no see? Who do you think you are?
{player_name} isn’t someone you talk to so lightly.

But we’ve adventured together back in the day.
We were friends...! Why can’t I greet an old friend?

Back in the day? Friend?
Is that why you dipped as soon as you got your fruit?

Stop talking and go do your job!
I’ll check out the balloons later.

O-okay, ma’am. I’m sorry...
{player_name}, I’ll see you later...

...I actually don’t hate Arjuna. Although he’s kind
of pathetic. But it’s fun messing around with him.

And I can’t believe someone like him came to work
at my orchard. My little orchard is becoming famous!

Anyway,
many things happened to me and my orchard.

But the biggest reason my orchard succeeded
is mainly you, {player_name}.

I met you because I was a pilot employed by Arjuna.
In that regard, I guess I appreciate him.

From the bottom of my heart, thank you {player_name}.
I look forward to continuing to work with you!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_187_STA.text:
Hey, {player_name}?
Do you want to hear an interesting story?

Did you hear Bridget talking
about the coming economic boom?

With that in mind, our Orchard has been preparing
even more berries to capitalize on the opportunity.

So I’ve been hiring new part-time employees.
Guess who showed up at the interview?

...Did you forget? The rich boy who flew around in
an aircraft? Did you forget that I was a pilot?

That rabbit... but he doesn’t have an ear anymore.
Then, I suppose he’s nothing...?

After removing his ears, he spent all his time fooling
around. He ended up spending all his inheritance money.

And the gold mine his family owns has been shutdown
due to the recent earthquake.

This is why you never take things for granted.
I work hard for my money despite having lots of cash.

The past is in the past, {player_name}. The present?
I’m a proud orchard owner and Arjuna is nothing.

I’m sure he won’t be a good employee.
But I’m still going to hire him.

I can legally order him around.
Just thinking about it makes me smile.

When he comes to work, I have to show him how to harvest.
{player_name}, can you help me with that?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_188_END.text:
Good, you’re here, {player_name}!
Sshh! Don’t yell!

I’m not lying!
I get nothing from scamming you!

I had it just a second ago!
Just wait a little bit. Popo is looking for it!

...It feels like someone snatched it from our hands.
I’ll find who did it.

When I find the culprit,
I’ll give him to you as well as a gift...!!!

The culprit is here!
Nyah! Go Toto!

Aahh! Who is this?!
Let go of me!
You are interfering with my business!

What are you talking about?!
You are the one kidnapping and trafficking my clients!

Kidnapping and trafficking?! You’re making it sound bad!
Popo is an honest merchant!

You kidnap and shove people inside your bag! How is that...
Wait, what?

What do you mean what?! Don’t act dumb!
Wait... your voice.

Sis?
Nene, is that you?
P-Popo..?

It’s you, Nene!
I missed you so much sis! It’s been years!

Uhm...
Ugh... I didn’t want to see you like this, Popo.

Explain what’s happening, {player_name}!
I said I miss Popo, but I didn’t want to see her yet!

Nyah? {player_name}? You and Nene know each other?
Why didn’t you tell me! Explain!
Mo... Mo...

Toto... you’re right. That’s not important right now.
We should thank {player_name} if anything.

So what’s going on here?
Care to explain?

I have so much to say! It’s been 8 years after all, Nene!
Hmm... first, I’ll return the product to you.

I’ll bring awesome products next time, {player_name}!
Thank you for everything! I’ll catch you later!
...So is anyone going to tell me what’s going on???

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_188_STA.text:
{player_name}, hear me out.
I have something HUGE to share!

Huh? That grass-colored ticket?
No, it’s something much better!

Promise you’ll keep this a secret.
Sshh! It’s only for you, {player_name}.

Popo and Toto has been doing some human tra-
“Hero product abductions.”

And I found something that I never saw before!
Doesn’t seem like human or demon... nyah...

I know your group has many people from other worlds!
But this is a bit different. You’ll see.

I’m sure this person I captured will be useful to you!
I’m sure you’ll love it!

This offer isn’t for anyone! It’s special, just for you!
{player_name} and I go way back, don’t we?

The #best products# are traded through private networks!
You are so naive, {player_name}!

The best products are never available off the shelf.
You need connections to get the best items!

I’m not spouting nonsense!
I want to repay you for all the help you gave me!

I’ll hold this product for you!
I’ll wait for you to come find me.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_189_END.text:
Yeah, I remember that event.
That’s how I looked when I turned into an apostle?

The fight we had, it was a spectacular one.
I don’t remember losing that quickly though...

It’s nice running a simulation of that event.
I can analyze what my problem was.

Hmph. If we go at it again, I bet I can beat you.
It’s unfair only you guys can ‘restart’ the event.

Maybe, if you had another traitor that joined my side...
Such as... Fergus?

But even during that difficult situation, I delivered
the fragment to El Thalnos. You can’t say I failed.

Oh, and I saw the Skill Lab on my way back.
There was a young mage transferring skills.

I’m... glad.
That Lab meant everything to me back then.

Before we point fingers and criticize,
I want to thank you.
For helping me with skill research back then...

It was nice talking to you, a walk down memory lane.
I’ll be going now, there are things I want to see.
{player_name}, you are truly a miracle to Pandora.

...Is it okay for you to point fingers and criticize now?
Uhm...

Wait, come sit, {player_name}.
Let’s talk more. {player_name}? Hello?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_189_STA.text:
Oh? Long time no see, {player_name}.
What’s with that expression? Seen a ghost?

...Look above my head?
The past? Elandia? El Thalnos?

Yeah, many things happened in the past.
But let’s put the past behind us.

You never know who you’ll run into.
It’s a pleasant surprise meeting you here.

There are the living dead in the desert.
I also gave you glasses that can see spirits.

This is evidence that the dead can be brought back.
The twisted dimensions might be the cause.

Whatever the case may be, the world sure is mysterious.
It might actually be a great research topic.

I’ve been doing okay. The afterlife isn’t a bad place.
I had fried chicken last night, it was delicious.
I was thinking everything was fine..

But seeing and talking to you, {player_name}
makes me reminisce on the past.

I miss the old days. Walk with me, will you?
Let’s visit Elandia and have a nice chat.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_190_END.text:
...We’re almost done.
It would’ve taken me ages to do it alone.

Did you read some stories?
Doesn’t it remind you of old memories?

It might feel strange reading something you already know.
But there are people that enjoy that.

To once again feel the emotion that they had felt.
To relive the excitement of the past.

Each individual has a different reason for reminiscing.
...Perhaps it’s because we lived a good past.

I sometimes stop and look back, too.
I get emotional whenever I read about our past.

I might sound a bit greedy here, but...
I wanted to record more of your adventures.

...We’re done reorganizing the books.
Thank you, {player_name}.

I’ve been watching over the dimensions for so long.
But the times we spent together seemed the longest.

I’ve been watching over you and Hasla.
Your stories were always so interesting.

...Whatever the ending might be.
As long as you’re here, the story never ends.

...You have a great story, {player_name}.
What do you think?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_190_STA.text:
...{player_name}. You look bored.
Can you help me if that’s the case?

I need to examine and organize the books. It’s a
necessary procedure, but it’s hard doing it alone.

Think about all the books and recordings the Library has!
It’s impossible to organize them alone.

When I’m tasked with the job, I barely finish on time.
It’s quite ridiculous.
...I spend 365 days a year organizing them...

I’ve been working like this for years.
Being a librarian isn’t easy.

The stories of every dimension are recorded here.
Every recent event as well.

And, {player_name}.
#Your stories# make up the majority of the library.
...But there’s too much for me to handle now.

Recent events alerted me to the gravity of the situation.
If I leave it be, the dimensions will become twisted.

So if you have time, you should look through the books.
It’s partially your fault that we’re in this situation.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_1_1.text:
I finally found you!
*Yawn* I was so bored♡

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_1_2.text:
I wanted to see who placed a bounty on my head,
and it was you! You are so slow♡

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_1_3.text:
You are a fool to come looking for me.
Well, I guess you saved me the trouble of finding you.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_1_4.text:
Since I came to you, you’re gonna pay me the bounty!
Haha♡ How nice! Free money!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_1_5.text:
You have no class. Such a rude kid.
I can’t see why so many people lost to you.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_1_6.text:
Class? Haha! The boss of a gang came for a child♡
Let’s see how you fare in a fight, loser♡

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_1_7.text:
...
I can’t let this kid disrupt the peace of our land.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_1.text:
Hmm!
I thought you were a complete loser♡ But you can fight!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_10.text:
Hmm? Are you trying to shoot me? I’m♡So♡Scared!
You want to make a child cry? You Brute♡

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_11.text: S-stop Milady! Let my tea friend go!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_12.text:
I never thought I’d make a new friend at my ripe old age!
Please show her mercy and let her go.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_13.text:
D-don’t! Keep her here!
Have her make delicious food for me...!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_14.text:
The food she makes is out of this world...
She needs to become a chef!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_15.text:
Ugh, losers♡ No one can keep me in one place.
How disgusting♡ Leave me alone, will you?♡

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_16.text:
I change my mind. I’m out of here♡
I hate clingy people♡

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_17.text:
NO! Don’t go please! Make me food!
Just tell me where you’re going, I’ll follow!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_18.text:
You’re going to leave me? Why! Don’t go!
I need your advice to improve my tea!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_19.text:
Whatever! Look at how clingy you all are♡
Don’t stalk me! Hope to never see you again! Bye losers♡

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_2.text:
You are pretty good.
Or maybe, it’s not you, maybe it’s {player_name}!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_22.text:
Otis, Athos, good job.
I’ll split the bounty and give it to you.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_23.text:
What worked? I don’t care about money!
I want my friend back!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_25.text:
...? What’s gotten into them?
{PLAYER_NAME}, do you know?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_26.text:
Better for me if they don’t want this money.
Come, Captain. Let’s have an expensive steak dinner.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_4.text:
Look at you getting angwy♡
No one likes grumpy people silly♡

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_6.text: Your face gets even wrinklier when angry♡ Haha♡

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_7.text:
Since you lost the duel, leave the Wastelands.
You disrupt our land’s order.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_8.text:
Nope♡
I’ll leave when I want to leave. It’s fun here♡

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_9.text:
Why you...! You leave me no choice.
A bullet is faster than the law...

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_1_1.text:
You’ve arrived.
I thought you’d come this way.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_1_2.text:
You said you’ll be going after the wanted crook.
Why were you waiting for me?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_1_3.text:
I did. I went after the bounty, but she was too strong.
I almost died while trying to earn a few coins.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_1_4.text:
So you came to me to tell me you failed?
You don’t have to report your incompetence to me...

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_1_6.text:
She told me if I bring her the person who placed
the bounty, she’d give me double what you offered.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_1_7.text:
You look weaker than her, Milady.
I have to stay alive until I find my brother.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_2_1_2.text: Sherff Maxi? Why are you here?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_2_1_3.text:
The money you sent me... You tried buying me off!
How dare you insult me like that! You’re under arrest!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_2_1_4.text: Hmm... I can’t let you do that.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_2_2_1.text:
Oh, wait! I didn’t send you enough!
A person of your caliber need more money!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_2_2_2.text:
Please excuse me, where were my manners?
I will order my men to donate an even bigger sum.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_2_2_3.text:
B-bigger sum? More than before?
Hmm... by how much?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_2_2_4.text:
N-No, wait!
You’re doing the same thing, again!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_2_2_5.text:
If that’s what you really want, I guess I will comply...
But the two horses and your new office. Give’em back.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_2_2_6.text: Wait...! All of that? G-give me a second to think.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_2_3_2.text:
I change my mind!
You weren’t bribing me! You simply donated!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_2_3_3.text:
You are no longer arrested!
Have a good day!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_3_1.text:
Hey, big shot.
Us bounty hunters live by a code. We have rules.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_3_2.text:
If you, the client, hunts for the bounty,
how would a hunter like me make money?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_3_3.text: This is unfair, don’t you think so?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_3_4.text:
If you worked diligently and competently, I wouldn’t
have to. Get out of my way.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_4_4.text: What the... this guy has food all over his mouth.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_4_5.text:
You can’t pass... I never had porridge that delicious...
The taste was heavenly...

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_4_6.text:
If you get rid of her,
I’ll never get to taste her leftovers, ever again...

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_4_7.text: What in the world did he eat?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_4_8.text: Heaven... one more time... I want to eat...

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_4_9.text: He’s insane. Speaking to him won’t do anything.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_5_1.text:
This is my territory. MINE.
You are brave to come here without your men.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_5_2.text:
This is the fastest path.
Can you make way?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_5_3.text:
No. I never really liked you.
You buy people’s favor with money and blackmail them.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_5_4.text:
It looks like you already have Maxi on your side.
That won’t work on me.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_6_1.text:
Milady, please don't! Why are you
trying to catch this talented individual?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_6_2.text:
I almost persuaded her to sign this contract here...
When she heard you were coming she changed her mind.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_7_1.text:
You were on my good side, since you brought peace to
the Wastelands. But I think you’re going too far.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_7_10.text: There are two of you. I needed to make it even.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_7_2.text:
You’re making such a mess, to simply go after 1 person?
Your game of tag is destroying the land!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_7_3.text:
I almost have her. Why are you making a fuss?
Just mind your own business.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_7_4.text:
We can’t let you off.
I heard you hurt Athos.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_7_6.text: Oh? Is that why you’re here?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_7_7.text:
So what? You are going to gang up on me
just because I bonked your brother?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_7_8.text:
Messing with one of us, is messing with us all.
We will show no mercy.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_7_9.text: But wait. Why is Captain {PLAYER_NAME} here?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_8_2.text:
Old man? Why are you here?
I thought I told you to stay at your shop.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_8_3.text:
That’s not it. Soon after you left, the kid came to my
shop again! I found out there was a misunderstanding.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_8_4.text:
She tried helping me with my tea research.
She was actually very knowledgeable about tea.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_8_5.text: She actually seemed more like an adult than most adults.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_8_6.text: Let’s cancel that bounty, shall we?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_8_8.text: No take backs. Get out of my way.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_9_1.text: You know who wiped out the 9th Division of the Falcons.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_9_2.text: Tell me who it is, or I’m not moving.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_9_3.text: Get out of my way, I’m busy.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_1.text:
Milady, did you catch that #rude kid# yet?
I placed such a big bounty on her, go get her!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_10.text:
I’ve never felt such humiliation before!
Maybe I should come out of retirement!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_11.text: Water that stops flowing eventually becomes dirty.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_12.text:
What? I, “Bloody Sunset” Otis is still alive and kicking!
I will teach that kid a lesson myself!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_13.text:
Just hold on. If you leave the Hideout
unattended, outsiders will trash our land.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_14.text:
I’ll take care of it.
I also have a useful #mercenary# that I hired.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_15.text:
Hmm... fine. But wait, why are you talking about to me?
Do you find me old and weak, too?!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_2.text:
I’ve sent my men after her.
Please wait a while longer old man.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_3.text:
You want me to wait longer?
I’ve waited for 4 days!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_4.text:
She called my tea #Loser♡# and left!
I want her dead!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_5.text: Loser... Loser... Loser... Loser Loser Loser Loser!!!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_6.text:
The smirk on her face...
I can’t get it out of my head!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_7.text:
There were many outsiders that visited you and your
shop, Hideout.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_8.text:
But #none walked out in one piece# after you
bonked them with your bottle.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_9.text:
But this one left without a scratch,
while further insulting you.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_2_2.text:
I’m surprised you’re here on time,
since you are always so clumsy and careless.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_2_4.text: I have someone I need to “take care” of.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_2_5.text:
You? Just follow me and support me.
Loot will fall all over the place, so pick’em up for yourself.

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D001.text: Hi! You finally read the message!

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D003.text: A new way to talk with others!

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D004.text: It’s an invention that will connect everyone from around the continent!

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D005.text: Let’s see... where do I start.

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D006.text: Oztalk is different from your traditional letters.

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D007.text: You can start a conversation with anyone at any time.

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D008.text: Do you know how to send a message?

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D010.text: That’s it! Good job. That’s how you do it.

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D012.text: You have a lot of friends.

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D013.text: I’m expecting you to spread the word of Oztalk!

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D014.text: You want me to promote Oztalk?

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D015.text: Yeah, there aren’t a lot of users yet.

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D016.text: But if you, the famous captain, uses it...!

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D017.text: People will catch on and start using it, too!

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D018.text: I do want to help you...

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D019.text: But I don’t know anyone that uses Oztalk.

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D020.text: I don’t even know how to add someone on this.

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D021.text: Adding a friend to Oztalk is easy!

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D022.text: First, you’ll have to have the hero [contracted and in your hero pool].

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D024.text: Then you’re ready to gain friendship with that hero!

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D025.text: It’s as if you’re explaining a game to me.

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D027.text: It was the easiest way to explain the system.

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D028.text: Oh! Remember that you can only accumulate friendship [with a select number of heroes].

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D029.text: I said this before, but Oztalk isn’t available to everyone yet.

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D030.text: How do I know who has access to Oztalk?

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D031.text: You can check at the [Oztalk Friends List]!

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D032.text: I’ll make it simple: [Recruit heroes in the Oztalk Friends List and promote them to 6 stars].

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D034.text: Then I need to accumulate [Friendship] with those heroes?

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D036.text: [You will receive more messages from heroes with high friendship.]

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D037.text: You can probably gain [Friendship] by buying them [Meat].

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D039.text: So I can raise friendship by playing [Scenarios], [Dungeons], and [Challenges] with those heroes?

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D041.text: I’ll probably also use Oztalk! So I’m expecting some delicious meat from you!

TEXT_TALK_001_1_D001.text:
[Web] (Ad) ☆★^@Need JOb?§○★100% joBGuaranteed^
☆Looking 4 ppl who want 2 wOr K*Gr8 treAtment, all rAces&GeNdErs

TEXT_TALK_001_1_D002.text:
///＃▷▷GEt FoRtuNE & leave Hur-sla beh1nd111▷★^ReSEttlemENt funds
pRov1ded§Cash, day of§▷★08012345678 to unsubscribe

TEXT_TALK_001_1_D006.text: Yes, of course! And I’ll give you a lot of money...

TEXT_TALK_001_1_D008.text:
Ehh? Captain? Ah-ha, sorry sorry!
It’s me, Nene!

TEXT_TALK_001_1_D009.text:
They said I could send a group message, so I tried it, but I keep forgetting to
remove people from the list.

TEXT_TALK_001_1_D010.text:
Oztalk is still pretty new, so I’m still
unfamiliar with all the functions.

TEXT_TALK_001_1_D012.text: No! This is the main hustle.

TEXT_TALK_001_1_D013.text:
Are you interested, Captain?
I’ll find you a sweet gig.

TEXT_TALK_001_1_D015.text: Hey, don’t be like that. At least hear me out.

TEXT_TALK_001_1_D016.text: Heh, you don’t know this?? Come on, I’ll teach you.

TEXT_TALK_001_1_D017.text:
Just trust me, will ya? You’ll earn lots of money and
there are loads of honorable quests waiting for you!

TEXT_TALK_001_1_D018.text:
For example, taking down a four-headed ogre
that’s settled on planet VAL-139...

TEXT_TALK_001_1_D019.text: That’s 7 times the bounty on Hasla! 7 TIMES!!

TEXT_TALK_001_1_D020.text:
Oh, if it’s that kind of work I’m OK.
Hasla work has me all tied up.

TEXT_TALK_001_1_D021.text:
Firm, I see. I thought you’d say that~
But if you change your mind, let me know!

TEXT_TALK_001_1_D022.text:
From you Captain, I’ll only take 40% of my headhunting
fee. I usually take 60% from everyone else, but that’s a trade secret, OK? Shh!

TEXT_TALK_001_1_D023.text:
Fine. By the way, how’d you get my contact info?
I don’t think I’ve given it to anyone yet.

TEXT_TALK_001_1_D024.text:
Ho ho~ No one knows it yet?
In that case, am I your first contact?♡
Hehe, what an honor!♡

TEXT_TALK_001_1_D026.text: There’s a~lways a way to find out someone’s contact info.

TEXT_TALK_001_1_D028.text:
Since you seem curious, I’ll tell you.
But it’s a secret! I bought it for 50 Gold! Shh!

TEXT_TALK_001_1_D029.text: 50...? My contact info... was worth 50? Not 50K?...

TEXT_TALK_001_1_D030.text:
Ho ho, all contact info is worth the same~
Anyway, I have to keep advertising! TTYL!

TEXT_TALK_001_2_D001.text:
[Web] (Ad) ★Leg. Horseman★Emplymnt Agncy/Strong talent/Discover unknown/
*F1ery* advntr/*HOT* growth/Sat. guaranteed 08012345678 to unsbscrbe

TEXT_TALK_001_2_D003.text:
Ah, Captain?
