TEXT_TALK_020_5_D026.text: I will check and take immediate action.

TEXT_TALK_021_1_D003.text: I heard that you helped put out the forest fire

TEXT_TALK_021_1_D004.text: that engulfed the Elven Realm’s Guardian Beast, Amalion

TEXT_TALK_021_1_D007.text:
...
Let’s just say it’s a compliment for your bravery.

TEXT_TALK_021_1_D008.text:
In truth, your help wasn’t
really crucial.

TEXT_TALK_021_1_D010.text: The elves were more than capable

TEXT_TALK_021_1_D015.text:
Did you have trouble understanding me?
I tried using ‘easy words’
so that someone of low status
such as yourself can understand.

TEXT_TALK_021_1_D016.text:
What’s up with your attitude?
Well, I suppose it’s expected
as you weren’t properly educated.

TEXT_TALK_021_1_D019.text:
I’m not trying to lecture you.
Don’t be too hard on yourself.

TEXT_TALK_021_1_D020.text:
It’s not really your fault.
Elves are just way better than every other race.

TEXT_TALK_021_1_D021.text:
You were born to an inferior race.
Of course you won’t be able to understand.

TEXT_TALK_021_1_D022.text:
Let me know if you find any of the vocabularies
I use too difficult to understand.

TEXT_TALK_021_1_D024.text:
Hmm?
I guess it was still too hard for you...
I don’t know how I can further simplify this.

TEXT_TALK_021_1_D028.text: reach out and ask for your help “FIRST”

TEXT_TALK_021_1_D032.text:
You are truly terrible at
talking to a lady of class.
The quality of non-Elven education must be rock bottom!

TEXT_TALK_021_1_D033.text:
At times like this, simply reply with, “Yes, my Queen.”
Do you understand?

TEXT_TALK_021_1_D034.text:
How kind of me
to teach you proper decorum!

TEXT_TALK_021_1_D037.text: Since you are incapable of giving me a proper reply

TEXT_TALK_021_1_D038.text: I’ll just assume that you DO agree with me, okay?

TEXT_TALK_021_1_D040.text:
What do you mean?
Are you saying I’m the one that didn’t understand?

TEXT_TALK_021_1_D042.text: Are you trying to humiliate me?

TEXT_TALK_021_1_D044.text: I’m so ashamed that I received help

TEXT_TALK_021_1_D045.text: from such a rude person of low class!

TEXT_TALK_021_1_D046.text: ...so you do acknowledge that you received my help.

TEXT_TALK_021_1_D050.text: Look at the text you sent me.

TEXT_TALK_021_1_D052.text: Are you trying to lecture me?

TEXT_TALK_021_1_D054.text: Don’t ever talk to me ever again!

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D002.text: I shall give you a chance to make things right.

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D004.text: I will ask you some questions and you will answer them

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D005.text:
It doesn’t count when I talk to you first.
You do know what ‘it doesn’t count’ means, right?

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D006.text: Hmm... do I really have to explain this to you?

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D007.text: Talking to you is truly a difficult task.

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D009.text: that you often meet with my father

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D013.text: So the rumors were true after all.

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D014.text:
Please just reply with either yes or no.
I’ll just assume you said ‘yes.’

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D015.text: Then are you also a pathetic idealist

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D016.text: who believes that all beings are born equal

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D019.text:
W-what?
I’ll give you a chance to reconsider.

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D020.text:
Answer my question.
I’ll just assume you said ‘no.’

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D021.text: Why are you even asking me these weird questions?

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D022.text: I’m trying to assess you as a person.

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D024.text: You are a human - an inferior, weak race...

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D026.text: You were chosen by the Goddesses.

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D027.text: You basically became a god-like person.

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D029.text:
*Sigh* Of course you wouldn’t understand.
The Goddesses surely didn’t choose you for your intelligence.

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D032.text: were chosen by a higher being

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D033.text: and ‘converted’ into what you are today.

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D034.text:
So I shall take my time
to assess you as a person.

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D036.text:
Interview? I suppose you aren’t as dumb as I thought
since you are using what you know as comparison to understand the current situation.

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D037.text: That will depend entirely on your behavior.

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D038.text:
It’s only natural for the inferior to be treated badly.
It’s natural selection - survival of the fittest.

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D039.text: I’m sure you would agree with me.

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D040.text: You are a powerful person with unmatched fame.

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D041.text: I’m sure you aren’t as foolish to say everyone is equal.

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D045.text:
What is your opinion?
Please answer me sincerely.

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D047.text:
What...?
That is your sincere answer?

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D049.text: Just think whatever you’d like, haha

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D051.text: How dare you speak to me like that

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D053.text: I was a fool to expect better from you!

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D055.text: I should be ashamed of myself...

TEXT_TALK_021_2_D056.text: Don’t ever text me or talk to me, ever again!

TEXT_TALK_021_3_D002.text:
I will give you a chance to mend our soured relationship
caused by your rudeness.

TEXT_TALK_021_3_D003.text: Will you take this said chance?

TEXT_TALK_021_3_D004.text: I know you are not as foolish to miss this opportunity.

TEXT_TALK_021_3_D005.text:
It is extremely frustrating to have long conversations with you.
So please just reply with either ‘Yes’ or ‘O’.

TEXT_TALK_021_3_D008.text: Of course you wouldn’t want to miss this chance.

TEXT_TALK_021_3_D009.text: I’ve been hearing that you also hang out with demons.

TEXT_TALK_021_3_D010.text: You befriend just about anyone, regardless of race or ethnicity...

TEXT_TALK_021_3_D011.text: I came to the conclusion that you’re either too ambitious

TEXT_TALK_021_3_D012.text: for a lost cause or you are just looking for attention.

TEXT_TALK_021_3_D014.text:
Hmm? Well of course!
It’s my thought, of course I think the way I want to.

TEXT_TALK_021_3_D015.text: Are you not aware of your own thoughts?

TEXT_TALK_021_3_D017.text: So what kind of “chance” are you exactly giving me?

TEXT_TALK_021_3_D019.text: Okay, I’ll get down to it.

TEXT_TALK_021_3_D022.text:
As expected.
When do you usually meet her?

TEXT_TALK_021_3_D023.text:
Where do you meet her?
Do you meet her often?

TEXT_TALK_021_3_D027.text: I just see her from time to time.

TEXT_TALK_021_3_D029.text: I feel like you are leaving out important information.

TEXT_TALK_021_3_D030.text: What were you going to say?

TEXT_TALK_021_3_D033.text: Are you trying to keep your mouth shut?

TEXT_TALK_021_3_D035.text: I’m sorry for not being a good help

TEXT_TALK_021_3_D038.text: Then you are going to miss your chance to receive

TEXT_TALK_021_3_D040.text: Then I will give you some time alone to figure it out.

TEXT_TALK_021_3_D041.text:
You still have a chance to make things right with me!
Think this through.

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D001.text: Did you figure out a way to recover our soured relations?

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D003.text:
D-did you perhaps forget about it?!
I thought you’d have better memory than average humans!

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D004.text:
N-not yet?
Even an ogre would think faster than you!

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D005.text: *Sigh* I guess you are still an ordinary human being.

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D006.text:
I’m beginning to doubt that the goddess actually
gave you their blessings.

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D008.text: Too much? Your foolishness is too much.

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D011.text: I’ll say this one more time

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D012.text: The way to repair my broken heart

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D013.text:
is for you to gather information regarding Vivian.
And to provide that information to me.

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D014.text: This way, you can prove your competence to me.

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D017.text: Good, good. How nice and compliant.

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D021.text: and even the smallest of her habits!

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D026.text: You know that Vivian and I fight once every year, right?

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D028.text:
W-what?!
Do you live under a rock?

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D029.text:
You didn’t know?
It’s one of the biggest news in Hasla!

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D033.text: Vivian is always locked up inside her room

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D035.text:
But this is
too hard to believe.

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D037.text:
What? It’s the truth?
I don’t believe you, either.

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D038.text:
S-she really does nothing else?
Nothing?

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D039.text: How can she become so powerful

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D041.text:
There’s no way a demon could be born
with such powerful natural talent.

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D042.text:
I’m sure there’s
something that she’s hiding.

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D043.text:
I want you to
figure that out for me.

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D049.text: Something that Vivian has, that you don’t.

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D058.text: Try wearing more comfortable clothes and try smiling

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D061.text: I feel like Vivian’s strength comes from that.

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D064.text: I guess I will g-give it a try!

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D066.text:
And...
Let me ask you a question.

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D067.text: Why do you use apostrophes so much when texting?

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D068.text: It’s so that I can put emphasis on certain words

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D069.text:
so that someone ‘foolish’ like you
can understand me ‘better’...!

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D070.text:
I didn’t think
you would ‘question’ me for that!

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D071.text: You don’t need to do that, I understand you.

TEXT_TALK_021_4_D074.text: Well, any way, please wait! I’ll come back more ‘relaxed’ than ever!

TEXT_TALK_021_5_D004.text: This is how I’m dressed right now.

TEXT_TALK_021_5_D005.text: I will send you a photo

TEXT_TALK_021_5_D009.text: I picked out the most comfortable clothes I have.

TEXT_TALK_021_5_D012.text: What’s that reaction? Tell me the truth

TEXT_TALK_021_5_D015.text: relax your muscles a bit more...

TEXT_TALK_021_5_D017.text: How do I relax my muscles?

TEXT_TALK_021_5_D019.text: and look for more comfortable clothing.

TEXT_TALK_021_5_D020.text: Ugh! I don’t know what to do!

TEXT_TALK_021_5_D021.text: I can’t believe someone of my class can be this clueless!

TEXT_TALK_021_5_D022.text: I’m totally embarrassed and ashamed of myself!

TEXT_TALK_021_5_D027.text: You will show it to me in person?

TEXT_TALK_021_5_D030.text: I want to learn about it immediately

TEXT_TALK_021_5_D031.text: I’m going to head to your house.

TEXT_TALK_022_1_D001.text: This is a device that I’m not too familiar with. Ozma informed me you are knowledgeable with it, so I’m sending you this letter. The reason I’m contacti

TEXT_TALK_022_1_D003.text: ...I accidentally sent the message before I finished

TEXT_TALK_022_1_D005.text: What brought you to message me on Oztalk?

TEXT_TALK_022_1_D006.text:
How convenient to receive your replies in real-time!
Ozma always creates the most fascinating devices!

TEXT_TALK_022_1_D007.text: The reason I messaged you is that...

TEXT_TALK_022_1_D008.text: I’m aware my family has troubled you in recent times.

TEXT_TALK_022_1_D009.text: Jack’s green monster, Ozma’s robot buddy, and more...

TEXT_TALK_022_1_D010.text: I heard Vivian dragged you into helping her.

TEXT_TALK_022_1_D011.text: Now that you mention it, yeah, she did...

TEXT_TALK_022_1_D012.text: On top of it all, Vivian is always raiding your mercenary group’s fridge every night.

TEXT_TALK_022_1_D013.text: What? I was wondering where all of our ice cream and frozen pizza went! It was Vivian!

TEXT_TALK_022_1_D014.text: Wait, but how do you know that? Are you really surveying Vivian 24/7...?

TEXT_TALK_022_1_D015.text: Ehem! That’s not important. What’s important is that I prepared a gift to thank you.

TEXT_TALK_022_1_D018.text: Hmm? You don’t know about this? I heard it’s popular amongst the younger generation.

TEXT_TALK_022_1_D019.text: Despite my looks, I always try my best to follow the trend.

TEXT_TALK_022_1_D020.text: This is a product made by Ozma and a patissier named Chocolat

TEXT_TALK_022_1_D021.text: You can use it anywhere, at any time to receive tasty dessert and milk by delivery

TEXT_TALK_022_1_D022.text: Of course, it’s still not comparable to freshly-made desserts, but it’ll still surprise you.

TEXT_TALK_022_1_D023.text: I really appreciate it, but there’s a minor problem...

TEXT_TALK_022_1_D025.text: It’s a 2-minute walk from my place to Chocolat’s Bakery.

TEXT_TALK_022_1_D027.text: The heroes at Hero Town are also allowed to eat at the bakery for free... you should give this gifticon to someone else.

TEXT_TALK_022_1_D028.text: I see... I should’ve been more considerate with my gift.

TEXT_TALK_022_1_D029.text: I will talk to you some other time.

TEXT_TALK_022_2_D001.text: Captain, did you receive the package I sent you?

TEXT_TALK_022_2_D002.text: I just received a confirmation text saying that the item has been delivered.

TEXT_TALK_022_2_D003.text: Oh... yeah. Tramontana just zoomed by. You sent me books?

TEXT_TALK_022_2_D004.text: The Prince, 13 Years in Demon Realm, Leader’s Pride, and Self-Defense for Old People...

TEXT_TALK_022_2_D005.text: Wait, I didn’t mean to send you that last book

TEXT_TALK_022_2_D006.text: The gifticon I sent you previously was no use to you,

TEXT_TALK_022_2_D007.text: so after some thought, I decided to send you books I read recently.

TEXT_TALK_022_2_D010.text: You truly are a marvelous character

TEXT_TALK_022_2_D011.text: Is that some kind of disease?

TEXT_TALK_022_2_D012.text: As a leader of various responsibilities, you aspire to cultivate various knowledge and skills, don’t you?

TEXT_TALK_022_2_D013.text: The books I sent you will be of great use to you.

TEXT_TALK_022_2_D014.text: Haha... I’m looking forward to them. I’ll read them when I get the chance.

TEXT_TALK_022_2_D015.text: Hmm... but why did you buy this self-defense book?

TEXT_TALK_022_2_D016.text: In truth, I’ve been feeling uneasy lately.

TEXT_TALK_022_2_D017.text: When I went to the bookstore to pick up some books, someone was following me, watching me.

TEXT_TALK_022_2_D020.text: I don’t have my advisors with me, so if that ‘someone’ was an assassin, I needed to defend myself.

TEXT_TALK_022_2_D021.text: Embarrassingly, all of my attacks are lethal.

TEXT_TALK_022_2_D022.text: Even if the person spying on me is an assassin, I can’t possibly take the life of a fellow demon. So I tried learning self-defense.

TEXT_TALK_022_2_D023.text: How thoughtful of you. No wonder you were such a decorated leader.

TEXT_TALK_022_2_D024.text: Ehem, so any way, can I have that book back?

TEXT_TALK_022_2_D025.text: I can just buy another, but I don’t want to go to the bookstore again.

TEXT_TALK_022_2_D026.text: Tramontana actually just zoomed by and snatched that book right off my hand a few minutes ago.

TEXT_TALK_022_2_D027.text: How did she know I would want it back?... She’s a freak of nature.

TEXT_TALK_022_3_D002.text: Did you finish reading the books I sent you?

TEXT_TALK_022_3_D004.text: You aren’t responding to my texts...

TEXT_TALK_022_3_D005.text: I forgot to tell you. Ozma implemented a special feature on my device.

TEXT_TALK_022_3_D006.text: I can tell if someone is ghosting my texts.

TEXT_TALK_022_3_D007.text: My device is telling you are.

TEXT_TALK_022_3_D009.text: You’re right. There’s no such feature

TEXT_TALK_022_3_D011.text: Uh... I didn’t ignore your texts because I didn’t read the books...

TEXT_TALK_022_3_D012.text: I was just playing with you.

TEXT_TALK_022_3_D013.text: I realized that less than half of the people that I gifted books to actually read them.

TEXT_TALK_022_3_D014.text: The only person that actually read them, and even submitted a book report, was Deokpal.

TEXT_TALK_022_3_D015.text: Anyways, do you remember the assassin I talked about last time?

TEXT_TALK_022_3_D016.text: I finally caught the culprit with my camera when I went to see Rachel’s concert.

TEXT_TALK_022_3_D019.text: Do you know who this is?

TEXT_TALK_022_3_D021.text: Captain, the demons live in an era where we cannot remark on someone’s color of skin. You can be framed as a bad demon for that.

TEXT_TALK_022_3_D022.text: Are you close with this person?

TEXT_TALK_022_3_D023.text: Of course... I knew you had a lot of friends, but I didn’t think you’d be this knowledgeable about demons.

TEXT_TALK_022_3_D025.text: It’s Asmodeus for sure. I don’t exactly know a lot about her though. So... why would she spy on you?

TEXT_TALK_022_3_D026.text: How should I know? But wait, I heard that name before.

TEXT_TALK_022_3_D027.text: Now that I know who she is, I’ll look into it.

TEXT_TALK_022_4_D002.text: I finally met and talked with Asmodeus.

TEXT_TALK_022_4_D005.text: You can compete at the arena some other time. Please hear what I have to say.

TEXT_TALK_022_4_D006.text: Hmm... how should I explain this.

TEXT_TALK_022_4_D007.text: Asmodeus was not an assassin. She was... a very special demon.

TEXT_TALK_022_4_D008.text: ...She said she is a ‘magical girl.’ She told me that she was watching me because I seemed like someone that’d be interested in that.

TEXT_TALK_022_4_D011.text: Really? Let’s become the best of friends then!

TEXT_TALK_022_4_D012.text: I wanted a friend that I can talk about the Magic Girl Chronicles with.

TEXT_TALK_022_4_D013.text: We decided to meet once in a while and talk about it.

TEXT_TALK_022_4_D014.text: Hmm... is that really all that Asmodeus wanted?

TEXT_TALK_022_4_D015.text: I know what you’re trying to say. But I’m a married man with two children.

TEXT_TALK_022_4_D016.text: Oh, right, you married twice, right?

TEXT_TALK_022_4_D017.text: Although I’m aware that Vivian and Rachel are your daughters

TEXT_TALK_022_4_D018.text: I constantly forget about it because of how young you look.

TEXT_TALK_022_4_D019.text: The 1st generation of demons keep their physical appearance the moment they turn into a demon - and we don’t age until the day we die.

TEXT_TALK_022_4_D020.text: I might look like a teenager to those who don’t know...

TEXT_TALK_022_4_D021.text: But I used to rule the Demon Realm... what demon wouldn’t know me?

TEXT_TALK_022_4_D022.text: You’re right. And I’m glad the assassin happened to be just Asmodeus.

TEXT_TALK_022_4_D023.text: It’s all thanks to you. I’ll buy you lunch.

TEXT_TALK_022_4_D024.text: I’d like that. I’d also like for the Elite Four to stop causing trouble.

TEXT_TALK_022_4_D025.text: I’ll relay that message to them.

TEXT_TALK_022_5_D001.text: Captain, are you at the Demon Realm?

TEXT_TALK_022_5_D003.text: The Elite Four caused trouble again?

TEXT_TALK_022_5_D005.text: It’s Asmodeus. I wanted to introduce her to you, so I invited her to lunch.

TEXT_TALK_022_5_D006.text: But... she got ahold of my address and... she sent a bouquet of flowers to the castle.

TEXT_TALK_022_5_D008.text: I just heard from Deokpal that Vivian rushed out in search for her.

TEXT_TALK_022_5_D009.text: ... Even Deokpal is questioning me, if I had been cheating on my wife.

TEXT_TALK_022_5_D010.text: You need to quickly find Vivian before someone gets hurt.

TEXT_TALK_022_5_D011.text: You’re right. I’m heading out now. If you get there before me, please keep Vivian from hurting anyone.

TEXT_TALK_023_1_D003.text: Captain, are you an honest person?

TEXT_TALK_023_1_D014.text: I wouldn’t take it that far!

TEXT_TALK_023_1_D015.text: But you like my look, right?!

TEXT_TALK_023_1_D019.text: This was a Magic Girl preference test.

TEXT_TALK_023_1_D020.text: And you were a fantastic help!

TEXT_TALK_023_1_D021.text: I created all sorts of Magic Girl things

TEXT_TALK_023_1_D022.text: But Suzume scolds me for making them...

TEXT_TALK_023_1_D023.text: so he wasn’t of any help.

TEXT_TALK_023_1_D025.text:
To be a Magic Girl
an outfit like this is a must-have!

TEXT_TALK_023_1_D026.text: I knew it was a good idea to contact you!

TEXT_TALK_023_1_D027.text: I want to become a splendid Magic Girl like Yuna!

TEXT_TALK_023_1_D028.text: So after evaluating her features and many online articles

TEXT_TALK_023_1_D029.text: I came up with this outfit!

TEXT_TALK_023_1_D031.text:
I’m running preference tests
to see what people like most in a Magic Girl!
Concept, poses, sizes...

TEXT_TALK_023_1_D032.text:
I want to become a popular Magic Girl when I grow up!
So I’m always trying my best.

TEXT_TALK_023_1_D034.text:
Thanks, I’m 11-years old now. And I’m constantly working
hard for my goals!

TEXT_TALK_023_1_D037.text: It’s time to do my homework.

TEXT_TALK_023_1_D038.text: I messaged you during my break.

TEXT_TALK_023_1_D039.text: By the way, my parents don’t know about this.

TEXT_TALK_023_1_D040.text: Can you keep this whole thing a secret?

TEXT_TALK_023_1_D041.text: I will pay you back one day!

TEXT_TALK_023_2_D005.text: I have something going on in my life right now.

TEXT_TALK_023_2_D007.text: so I messaged you for your opinion.

TEXT_TALK_023_2_D009.text: Give me your honest opinion, okay?

TEXT_TALK_023_2_D015.text: What do you think about this incantation?

TEXT_TALK_023_2_D023.text: Riding the wind to your location!★

TEXT_TALK_023_2_D029.text: Do you think it was bad?

TEXT_TALK_023_2_D033.text: It was in one of the directions of the

TEXT_TALK_023_2_D034.text: ‘How to become the perfect magic girl’ instruction book.

TEXT_TALK_023_2_D036.text:
Or... Captain,
will you make one for me?

TEXT_TALK_023_2_D037.text: Please make one that fits me well!

TEXT_TALK_023_2_D038.text: If you do a good job

TEXT_TALK_023_2_D039.text:
I will buy you milk jelly
once I get my allowance

TEXT_TALK_023_2_D040.text: I get my allowance in 2 days

TEXT_TALK_023_2_D045.text:
It’s not terrible...
but it sounds a bit childish.
I’m a big sis now, you know

TEXT_TALK_023_2_D048.text: I guess the one I made is the best, right?

TEXT_TALK_023_2_D050.text: That’s not true! Not true at all!

TEXT_TALK_023_2_D052.text: Okay, then from here on out

TEXT_TALK_023_2_D053.text:
Hina’s Magic Girl Incantation
will be this!

TEXT_TALK_023_2_D058.text:
Uhm...
I didn’t ask for much! Just type in *Clap Clap*!

TEXT_TALK_023_2_D060.text: You were a great help to me again.

TEXT_TALK_023_2_D061.text: It’s time for me to do homework, so I’ll see you later.

TEXT_TALK_023_2_D062.text: But once I get my allowance, I’ll buy you the promised milk jelly

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D002.text: I have something to discuss with you!

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D004.text: You are curious about it, right?

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D008.text:
You are at least
10 years older than me, right?

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D009.text: So you should be smarter than me!

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D012.text: As I got older, my perspective on the world changed!

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D014.text: He is a very small and cute friend!

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D015.text: He always sticks by my side

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D016.text: and even cuddles with me when sleeping

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D017.text: I’m old now so I’m not scared to sleep alone, but he is!

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D018.text: But anyways, one day, I woke up during the middle of the night

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D019.text: and my friend was nowhere to be found

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D020.text: So I went out looking for him as I was worried.

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D022.text: That’s when I heard a strange noise...

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D026.text: He was talking with my grandma... they were whispering.

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D027.text: They were having a secret conversation of some sort!

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D029.text:
The thing is, I’ve never seen them talk like that before.
They barely know each other!

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D031.text:
They were startled
and disappeared without a trace!

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D033.text:
When I returned to my room,
my friend was in the bed sleeping

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D036.text: But I found a leaf stuck on his wings

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D040.text: I asked my friend where he went off to last night

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D041.text: and he said he never left the bed!

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D045.text: You are thinking what I’m thinking, right?

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D046.text: It’s not enough information to say something’s wrong...

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D050.text: That friend was the one that approached me first and told me he’ll turn me into a Magic Girl.

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D051.text: Because of him, I gave up on my studies at Neth and returned to Ryu...

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D052.text: But I don’t know if he’s actually helping me...

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D053.text: Nothing’s changed. I’m still studying like normal...

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D054.text:
I’m training in exorcism
and I can’t leave Ryu.

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D055.text: If I want to study things outside of exorcism, I have to get permission from the adults.

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D056.text: I have to defeat Seimei, Ryu’s nemesis

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D057.text: but my friend told me I can also become Magic Girl in the process.

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D058.text: I’m taking Magic Girl training in secrecy, all by myself.

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D060.text: Yeah! Do you think maybe Hina was fooled?!

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D065.text: The truth is always more painful than it should be...

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D066.text:
But I will take your advice
and assess the situation a bit more.

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D068.text: I really like my friend. I want to believe him.

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D069.text: Just imagining that he lied to me

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D071.text: I shouldn’t doubt him just yet.

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D006.text: Let me get down to it.

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D008.text: I have someone I want to learn about.

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D009.text: I heard you know a lot of people, so I’m asking you.

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D011.text:
What???
You are friends with YUNA?!
OMG!
Well anyways, before we talk about that...

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D013.text: I want to learn about Seimei!

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D021.text: If it’s similar to what you know, tell me.

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D025.text: Did Seimei try eating you, too?

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D027.text: I don’t know about it in detail, but I heard Seimei swallows people whole!

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D028.text: It might be because you’re so strong!

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D030.text: I heard Seimei has devilish fangs and teeth

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D035.text: ...Devilish isn’t a word I’d use to describe Seimei...

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D036.text: Seimei is actually quite... soft and delicate...

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D037.text: Seimei is nothing like what you’ve described

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D039.text: The adults at Ryu all believe Seimei is an evil being.

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D040.text: They told me Seimei will eat me and take my body if I run into it.

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D041.text: They told me I need to continue my training if I want to defeat Seimei.

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D044.text: So anyway, you’re telling me Seimei is nothing like what the adults at Ryu described, right?

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D045.text: There might be something you don’t know?

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D046.text: There should be a good reason as to why the people at Ryu told you those stories.

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D047.text:
But the Seimei I know
isn’t a bad person.

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D049.text: The adults might be wrong then

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D051.text: My grandma is calling for me

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D053.text: She’ll scold me if I don’t go!

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D055.text: I will buy you two jellies!

TEXT_TALK_023_5_D003.text: I have important matter to discuss!

TEXT_TALK_023_5_D006.text: Yeah, okay I’ll run away from home

TEXT_TALK_023_5_D009.text: I’m sorry to surprise you with this sudden news

TEXT_TALK_023_5_D010.text: But I’ve already completed all preparations

TEXT_TALK_023_5_D011.text: I’ve already completed all preparations, so I had no choice

No...?
I didn’t think you wouldn’t help me...

I have a place I need to be
after I run away from home!
